title_en: DiffuMamba: High-Throughput Diffusion LMs with Mamba Backbone
title_zh: DiffuMamba：以 Mamba 为骨干的高吞吐扩散语言模型

sentences.en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) generation, yet their reliance on Transformer backbones limits inference efficiency due to quadratic attention or KV-cache overhead.
sentences.zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）已成为自回归（AR）生成的有前景替代方案，然而它们对 Transformer 主干的依赖因二次注意力或 KV 缓存开销限制了推理效率。

sentences.en: We introduce DiffuMamba, a masked diffusion language model built on a bidirectional Mamba backbone that combines the diffusion objective with linear-time sequence modeling, and DiffuMamba-H, a hybrid variant with interleaved attention.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 DiffuMamba，一个构建在双向 Mamba 主干上的掩码扩散语言模型，它将扩散目标与线性时间序列建模相结合，以及 DiffuMamba-H，一个带交错注意力的混合变体。

sentences.en: Across scales up to 1.3B parameters, our models match Transformer-based diffusion in downstream performance while achieving up to 8.2× and 4.3× higher inference throughput, respectively, on long sequences.
sentences.zh: 在高达 1.3B 参数的规模上，我们的模型在下游性能上匹配基于 Transformer 的扩散，同时在长序列上分别实现至多 8.2\times 与 4.3\times 的更高推理吞吐量。

sentences.en: We further present a systematic analysis of inference efficiency across modern DLM variants, combining asymptotic complexity with empirical measurements.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步结合渐近复杂度与实证测量，对现代 DLM 变体的推理效率进行系统性分析。

sentences.en: Notably, cache-efficient block diffusion with Mamba mixers emerges as the only strategy that scales linearly with sequence length and achieves the strongest performance across all baselines, suggesting a promising direction for future diffusion-based generation systems.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，带 Mamba 混合器的缓存高效块扩散成为唯一随序列长度线性扩展并在所有基线上取得最强性能的策略，这为未来基于扩散的生成系统指出一个有前景的方向。

title_en: DiffuReason: Enhancing  Reasoning Ability for Diffusion Language Models via Monte Carlo Tree Search
title_zh: DiffuReason：通过蒙特卡洛树搜索增强扩散语言模型推理能力

sentences.en: Auto-Regressive (AR) models with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) are a dominant paradigm for achieving “System 2” reasoning.
sentences.zh: 带蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的自回归（AR）模型是实现“系统 2”推理的主导范式。

sentences.en: However, this approach suffers from significant latency due to the serial, token-by-token generation mechanism of AR models.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种方法由于 AR 模型的串行、逐词元生成机制而遭受显著延迟。

sentences.en: In contrast, Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) offer inherent speed advantages via parallel sequence generation, yet they often struggle with accuracy in complex reasoning due to a lack of rigorous search, evaluation, and revision capabilities.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过并行序列生成提供内在的速度优势，然而由于缺乏严谨的搜索、评估与修正能力，它们在复杂推理中的准确率常常表现挣扎。

sentences.en: Directly applying MCTS to diffusion models faces architectural barriers, since the denoising generation process lacks the discrete decision steps that naturally accommodate tree search.
sentences.zh: 直接将 MCTS 应用于扩散模型面临架构障碍，因为去噪生成过程缺乏自然容纳树搜索的离散决策步骤。

sentences.en: To retain efficiency while improving the reasoning ability, we propose DiffuReason, a Monte Carlo tree search reasoning algorithm for diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 为在改进推理能力的同时保持效率，我们提出 DiffuReason，一种用于扩散模型的蒙特卡洛树搜索推理算法。

sentences.en: By modeling the generation process as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), DiffuReason discretizes the continuous diffusion flow into searchable thought blocks.
sentences.zh: 通过将生成过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），DiffuReason 将连续的扩散流离散化为可搜索的思想块。

sentences.en: During the reverse generation process, DiffuReason recursively performs four MCTS-style stages: select the best node (block), expand to obtain candidate nodes, simulate to evaluate node values, and revise the unsatisfactory nodes.
sentences.zh: 在逆向生成过程中，DiffuReason 递归地执行四个 MCTS 式阶段：选择最佳节点（块）、扩展以获得候选节点、模拟以评估节点值，以及修正不满意的节点。

sentences.en: Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DiffuReason significantly improves the reasoning ability of diffusion models, and achieves superior balance of accuracy and efficiency even compared with auto-regressive models.
sentences.zh: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，DiffuReason 显著提高扩散模型的推理能力，并且即使在自回归模型中也实现了准确率与效率的优越平衡。

title_en: Diffuse to Detect: Bi-Level Sample Rebalancing with Pseudo-Label Diffusion for Point-Supervised Infrared Small-Target Detection
title_zh: 以扩散实现检测：通过伪标签扩散进行双层样本再平衡，用于点监督红外小目标检测

sentences.en: Point supervision has become a scalable solution to address dense annotation for infrared small target detection, but its performance is limited by two coupled bottlenecks: unstable pseudo-label evolution in cluttered, low-contrast infrared imagery and severe sample-distribution imbalance.
sentences.zh: 点监督已成为应对红外小目标检测密集标注的可扩展解决方案，但其性能受到两个耦合瓶颈的限制：在杂乱、低对比度红外图像中不稳定的伪标签演化，以及严重的样本分布不平衡。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present a more adaptive and stable framework to address these issues.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一个更具自适应性与稳定性的框架来应对这些问题。

sentences.en: Leveraging the intrinsic consistency between thermal radiation patterns and heat diffusion, we propose a physics-induced annotation strategy that expands single-point labels into reliable pseudo-masks.
sentences.zh: 利用热辐射模式与热扩散之间的内在一致性，我们提出一种物理诱导的标注策略，将单点标签扩展为可靠的伪掩码。

sentences.en: To further enhance supervision and alleviate sample imbalance, we develop a bi-level dual-update framework that jointly optimizes detector weights, sample weights, and diffusion parameters.
sentences.zh: 为进一步增强监督并缓解样本不平衡，我们开发一个双层双更新框架，它联合优化检测器权重、样本权重与扩散参数。

sentences.en: A meta-classifier dynamically predicts sample-wise loss weights, while a differentiable diffusion module refines pseudo-labels with detection feedback, enabling adaptive interaction between training and hyperparameter optimization.
sentences.zh: 一个元分类器动态预测逐样本损失权重，而一个可微的扩散模块用检测反馈精炼伪标签，实现训练与超参数优化之间的自适应交互。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate five-fold annotation acceleration, superior detection accuracy, and comparable performance with 30\% of the training data, validating the efficiency and practicality of our approach.
sentences.zh: 跨多个数据集的大量实验展示了五倍的标注加速、卓越的检测准确率以及用 30\% 训练数据实现的相当性能，验证了我们方法的效率与实用性。

title_en: Diffusing to Coordinate: Efficient Online Multi-Agent Diffusion Policies
title_zh: 通过扩散实现协调：高效在线多智能体扩散策略

sentences.en: Online Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is a prominent framework for efficient agent coordination.
sentences.zh: 在线多智能体强化学习（MARL）是高效智能体协调的突出框架。

sentences.en: Crucially, enhancing policy expressiveness is pivotal for achieving superior performance.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，增强策略表达力对于实现卓越性能至关重要。

sentences.en: Diffusion-based generative models are well-positioned to meet this demand, having demonstrated remarkable expressiveness and multimodal representation in image generation and offline settings.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散的生成模型非常适合满足这一需求，它们已在图像生成与离线情境中展现出非凡的表达力与多模态表示。

sentences.en: Yet, their potential in online MARL remains largely under-explored.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们在在线 MARL 中的潜力在很大程度上仍未充分探索。

sentences.en: A major obstacle is that the intractable likelihoods of diffusion models impede entropy-based exploration and coordination.
sentences.zh: 一个主要障碍是扩散模型不可处理的似然阻碍了基于熵的探索与协调。

sentences.en: To tackle this challenge, we propose among the first Online off-policy MARL framework using Diffusion policies (**OMAD**) to orchestrate coordination.
sentences.zh: 为攻克这一挑战，我们提出首批使用扩散策略（**OMAD**）编排协调的在线离策略 MARL 框架之一。

sentences.en: Our key innovation is a relaxed policy objective that maximizes scaled joint entropy, facilitating effective exploration without relying on tractable likelihood.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键创新是一个松弛的策略目标，它最大化缩放的联合熵，在无需可处理似然的情况下促进有效探索。

sentences.en: Complementing this, within the centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) paradigm, we employ a joint distributional value function to optimize decentralized diffusion policies.
sentences.zh: 与此相辅相成，在集中式训练与去中心化执行（CTDE）范式中，我们采用一个联合分布值函数来优化去中心化扩散策略。

sentences.en: It leverages tractable entropy-augmented targets to guide the simultaneous updates of diffusion policies, thereby ensuring stable coordination.
sentences.zh: 它利用可处理的熵增强目标指导扩散策略的同步更新，从而确保稳定协调。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on MPE and MAMuJoCo establish our method as the new state-of-the-art across $10$ diverse tasks, demonstrating a remarkable $2.5\times$ to $5\times$ improvement in sample efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在 MPE 与 MAMuJoCo 上的广泛评估将我们的方法确立为跨 $10$ 个多样任务的新最先进水平，展示了样本效率上非凡的 $2.5\times$ 到 $5\times$ 改进。

title_en: Diffusion Bridge or Flow Matching? A Unifying Framework and Comparative Analysis
title_zh: 扩散桥还是流匹配？统一框架与比较分析

sentences.en: Diffusion Bridge and Flow Matching have both demonstrated compelling empirical performance in transformation between arbitrary distributions.
sentences.zh: 扩散桥与流匹配在任意分布之间的变换中都展现出令人信服的实证性能。

sentences.en: However, there remains confusion about which approach is generally preferable, and the substantial discrepancies in their modeling assumptions and practical implementations have hindered a unified theoretical account of their relative merits.
sentences.zh: 然而，关于哪种方法普遍更优仍存在困惑，并且它们在建模假设与实践实现上的显著差异妨碍了对各自优点的统一理论说明。

sentences.en: We have, for the first time, provided a unified theoretical and experimental validation of these two models.
sentences.zh: 我们首次为这两种模型提供了统一的理论与实验验证。

sentences.en: We recast their frameworks through the lens of Stochastic Optimal Control and prove that the cost function of the Diffusion Bridge is lower, guiding the system toward more stable and natural trajectories.
sentences.zh: 我们通过随机最优控制的视角重新阐释它们的框架，并证明扩散桥的成本函数更低，引导系统走向更稳定、更自然的轨迹。

sentences.en: Simultaneously, from the perspective of Optimal Transport, interpolation coefficients $t$ and $1-t$ of Flow Matching become increasingly ineffective when the training data size is reduced.
sentences.zh: 同时，从最优输运的视角看，当训练数据规模减小时，流匹配的插值系数 t 与 1-t 变得越来越无效。

sentences.en: To corroborate these theoretical claims, we propose a novel, powerful architecture for Diffusion Bridge built on a latent Transformer, and implement a Flow Matching model with the same structure to enable a fair performance comparison in various experiments.
sentences.zh: 为佐证这些理论主张，我们提出一个构建在潜在 Transformer 之上的新颖、强大的扩散桥架构，并实现一个具有相同结构的流匹配模型，以便在各种实验中实现公平的性能比较。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments are conducted across Image Restoration, Translation, and Style Transfer tasks, systematically varying both the distributional discrepancy (different difficulty) and the training data size.
sentences.zh: 我们在图像恢复、翻译与风格迁移任务上进行综合实验，系统性地改变分布差异（不同难度）与训练数据规模。

sentences.en: Extensive empirical results align perfectly with our theoretical predictions and allow us to delineate the respective advantages and disadvantages of these two models.
sentences.zh: 大量的实证结果与我们的理论预测完美吻合，并使我们能够描绘这两种模型各自的优缺点。

sentences.en: Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/zhukaizhen/diffusion_bridge_flow_matching}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/zhukaizhen/diffusion_bridge_flow_matching 获取。

title_en: Diffusion Controller: Framework, Algorithms and Parameterization
title_zh: 扩散控制器：框架、算法与参数化

sentences.en: Controllable diffusion generation often relies on various heuristics that are seemingly disconnected without a unified understanding.
sentences.zh: 可控扩散生成常常依赖各种看似不连贯、缺乏统一理解的启发式方法。

sentences.en: We bridge this gap with Diffusion Controller (DiffCon), a unified control-theoretic view that casts reverse diffusion sampling as state-only stochastic control within (generalized) linearly-solvable Markov Decision Processes (LS-MDPs).
sentences.zh: 我们用扩散控制器（DiffCon）弥合这一差距，这是一个统一的控制论视角，它将逆向扩散采样投射为（广义的）线性可解马尔可夫决策过程（LS-MDP）内的仅状态随机控制。

sentences.en: Under this framework, control acts by reweighting the pretrained reverse-time transition kernels, balancing terminal objectives against an $f$-divergence cost.
sentences.zh: 在此框架下，控制通过重新加权预训练的逆向时间转移核发挥作用，在终端目标与 f 散度成本之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: From the resulting optimality conditions, we derive practical reinforcement learning methods for diffusion fine-tuning: (i) $f$-divergence-regularized policy-gradient updates, including a PPO-style rule, and (ii) a regularizer-determined reward-weighted regression objective with a minimizer-preservation guarantee under the Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence.
sentences.zh: 从所得的最优性条件，我们为扩散微调推导出实用的强化学习方法：（i）f 散度正则化的策略梯度更新，包括一个 PPO 式规则，以及（ii）一个由正则化器决定的奖励加权回归目标，在 Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度下具有保持极小值点的保证。

sentences.en: The LS-MDP framework further implies a principled model form: the optimal score decomposes into a fixed pretrained baseline plus a lightweight control correction, motivating a side-network parameterization conditioned on exposed intermediate denoising outputs, enabling effective *gray-box adaptation* with a frozen backbone.
sentences.zh: LS-MDP 框架进一步暗示一个有原则的模型形式：最优分数分解为一个固定的预训练基线加上一个轻量级控制修正，激发一个以暴露的中间去噪输出为条件的侧网络参数化，实现带冻结主干的有效的*灰盒适配*。

sentences.en: Experiments on Stable Diffusion v1.4 across supervised and reward-driven finetuning show consistent gains in preference-alignment win rates and improved quality–efficiency trade-offs versus gray-box baselines and even the parameter-efficient white-box adapter LoRA.
sentences.zh: 在 Stable Diffusion v1.4 上的监督与奖励驱动微调实验表明，与灰盒基线乃至参数高效的百盒适配器 LoRA 相比，在偏好对齐胜率上取得一致的增益，并改善质量-效率权衡。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Diffusion Differentiable Resampling
title_zh: 扩散可微重采样

sentences.en: This paper is concerned with differentiable resampling in the context of sequential Monte Carlo (e.g., particle filtering).
sentences.zh: 本文关注序贯蒙特卡洛（例如粒子滤波）语境中的可微重采样。

sentences.en: Drawing on reparametrisation, we propose a new resampling method that is informative and instantly differentiable, based on a training-free diffusion model surrogate.
sentences.zh: 借鉴重参数化，我们提出一种新的重采样方法，它基于免训练的扩散模型代理而具有信息量且即刻可微。

sentences.en: We theoretically prove that our diffusion resampling method provides a consistent resampling distribution, and we show empirically that it outperforms the state-of-the-art differentiable resampling methods on multiple filtering and parameter estimation benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上证明我们的扩散重采样方法提供一致的重采样分布，并在多个滤波与参数估计基准上经验表明它超越最先进的可微重采样方法。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that it achieves competitive end-to-end performance when used in learning a complex dynamics-decoder model with high-dimensional image observations.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明在用于学习带高维图像观测的复杂动力学-解码器模型时，它实现了有竞争力的端到端性能。

title_en: Diffusion Flow Matching: Dimension-Improved KL Bounds and Wasserstein Guarantees
title_zh: 扩散流匹配：维度依赖更优的 KL 界与 Wasserstein 保证

sentences.en: Diffusion Flow Matching (DFM) has recently emerged as a versatile framework for generative modeling, yet its theoretical convergence properties remain only partially understood.
sentences.zh: 扩散流匹配（DFM）近来已成为生成建模的通用框架，然而其理论收敛性质仍仅被部分理解。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide refined and novel convergence guarantees for Brownian motion based DFMs, focusing on the  discretization error.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们为基于布朗运动的 DFM 提供精炼且新颖的收敛保证，聚焦于离散化误差。

sentences.en: Our analysis is conducted under the Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence and the 2-Wasserstein distance.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析在 Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度与 2-Wasserstein 距离下进行。

sentences.en: Under finite-moment and mild integrability assumptions, we derive KL convergence bounds with improved dimensional dependence compared to prior work, achieving, up to our knowledge, state-of-the-art scaling under minimal conditions.
sentences.zh: 在有限矩与温和可积性假设下，我们推导出相较先前工作具有改进维度依赖的 KL 收敛界，据我们所知，在最小条件下实现了最先进的缩放。

sentences.en: We further extend the analysis to the 2-Wasserstein distance: assuming weak log-concavity and one-sided Lipschitz continuity, we obtain convergence guarantees with dimensional dependence consistent with the KL case.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将分析扩展到 2-Wasserstein 距离：假设弱对数凹性与单侧 Lipschitz 连续性，我们获得与 KL 情形一致的维度依赖收敛保证。

title_en: Diffusion Language Model Parallel Decoding via Product-of-Experts Bridge
title_zh: 通过专家乘积桥实现扩散语言模型并行解码

sentences.en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer substantial speed advantages through parallel decoding, but the lack of token dependencies limits generation quality compared to autoregressive (AR) models.
sentences.zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）通过并行解码提供可观的速度优势，但与自回归（AR）模型相比，词元依赖的缺乏限制了生成质量。

sentences.en: Recent progress attempts to bridge the gap via importance sampling, with DLM being the proposal and AR being the target.
sentences.zh: 近期进展尝试通过重要性采样弥合这一差距，以 DLM 作为提议、AR 作为目标。

sentences.en: However, due to the huge gap between their distributions, the sampling requires a large number of particles and is thus expensive to compute.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于它们分布之间的巨大差距，采样需要大量粒子，因此计算昂贵。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce PoE-Bridge, a novel decoding framework that drastically improves generation speed and accuracy by introducing an intermediate distribution to bridge the gap.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入 PoE-Bridge，一个新颖的解码框架，它通过引入一个中间分布来弥合差距，大幅提升生成速度与准确率。

sentences.en: The distribution is constructed as a Product-of-Experts (PoE) of the DLM proposal and the AR target.
sentences.zh: 该分布被构建为 DLM 提议与 AR 目标的专家之积（PoE）。

sentences.en: With the intermediate distribution, we first use the DLM to draft multiple continuations in parallel, then apply rejection sampling to verify the drafted tokens and move the resulting candidates toward the PoE. We then use importance sampling to further correct the PoE-aligned candidates toward the AR target.
sentences.zh: 借助中间分布，我们首先使用 DLM 并行起草多个续写，然后应用拒绝采样验证草稿词元，并将所得候选移向 PoE。然后，我们使用重要性采样进一步将 PoE 对齐的候选校正向 AR 目标。

sentences.en: We further propose several improved techniques, including mixed-temperature sampling for enhanced diversity and elastic rejection windows for reducing wasted verification.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出若干改进技术，包括用于增强多样性的混合温度采样与用于减少浪费验证的弹性拒绝窗口。

sentences.en: Empirically, PoE-Bridge achieves significantly improved accuracy with $5\times$ speedup over the standard DLM decoding approach, and recovers at least 95% of the target AR model's performance, efficiently advancing most of the quality gap on challenging mathematical reasoning and coding tasks.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，PoE-Bridge 在标准 DLM 解码方法上实现显著改进的准确率与 $5\times$ 的加速，并恢复目标 AR 模型至少 95% 的性能，在具有挑战性的数学推理与编码任务上高效地推进了大部分质量差距。

sentences.en: Our code is available at [https://github.com/juntongshi48/poe-bridge](https://github.com/juntongshi48/poe-bridge).
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/juntongshi48/poe-bridge 获取。

title_en: Diffusion Models Are Statistically Optimal for Learning Low-Dimensional Multi-Modal Distributions
title_zh: 扩散模型在学习低维多峰分布方面具有统计最优性

sentences.en: Score-based diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable empirical success in learning high-dimensional distributions, particularly those exhibiting low-dimensional and multi-modal structures.
sentences.zh: 基于分数的扩散模型在学习高维分布（尤其是展现出低维与多模态结构的分布）方面展现出卓著的实证成功。

sentences.en: However, theoretical understanding of their statistical efficiency remains limited.
sentences.zh: 然而，对其统计效率的理论理解仍然有限。

sentences.en: Existing theories typically rely on strong regularity assumptions, such as uniformly bounded densities or globally smooth score functions, which fail to capture such intrinsic structures.
sentences.zh: 现有理论通常依赖强正则性假设，例如一致有界密度或全局光滑的分数函数，这些未能捕获此类内在结构。

sentences.en: In this work, we study the sample complexity of diffusion models for learning distributions supported on a union of low-dimensional subspaces.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究扩散模型学习支撑在低维子空间并集上的分布的样本复杂度。

sentences.en: Assuming that the data distribution within each subspace is subgaussian, we show that diffusion models require at most the order of $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-k \vee 2})$ (up to some logarithmic factor) samples to achieve $\varepsilon$ sampling error in 1-Wasserstein distance, where $k$ is the intrinsic dimension.
sentences.zh: 假设每个子空间内的数据分布是亚高斯的，我们表明扩散模型需要至多 O~(epsilon^-(k 与 2 取最大))（至多在对数因子内）的样本，以在 1-Wasserstein 距离下实现 epsilon 采样误差，其中 k 是内在维度。

sentences.en: This near-optimal convergence rate depends only on the intrinsic dimension and significantly improves upon prior theoretical guarantees that suffer from the curse of dimensionality.
sentences.zh: 这一近最优的收敛速率仅取决于内在维度，并显著改进于遭受维度灾难的先前理论保证。

sentences.en: Notably, our analysis applies to a broad collection of distributions without imposing smoothness, bounded-density, or log-concavity assumptions.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们的分析适用于广泛的分布集合，无需施加光滑性、有界密度或对数凹性假设。

sentences.en: Overall, our results show that diffusion models can statistically adapt to intrinsic low-dimensional structure while naturally accommodating multi-modal data, offering a rigorous theoretical justification for their success in complex high-dimensional learning tasks.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明，扩散模型可以统计上适应内在低维结构，同时自然地容纳多模态数据，为其在复杂高维学习任务中的成功提供了严谨的理论依据。

title_en: Diffusion Models Preferentially Memorize Prototypical Examples or: Why Does My Diffusion Model Love Slop?
title_zh: 扩散模型优先记忆典型样本，或：为什么我的扩散模型偏爱低质内容？

sentences.en: Generative models have a persistent limitation: their tendency to memorize training data can create legal liabilities and erode creative diversity.
sentences.zh: 生成模型有一个持续存在的局限：它们记忆训练数据的倾向会造成法律责任并侵蚀创作多样性。

sentences.en: Understanding which samples  are memorized in whole or in part, and under what conditions, therefore remains an important open problem.
sentences.zh: 因此，理解哪些样本被整体或部分记忆、在何种条件下被记忆，仍是一个重要的开放问题。

sentences.en: Here we answer the question "Are atypical or rare samples memorized first?" in the negative.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们对“非典型或罕见样本会先被记忆吗？”这一问题给出了否定回答。

sentences.en: We train diffusion models on strings generated according to the production rules of the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), and find that samples composed of *common substrings* are preferentially memorized.
sentences.zh: 我们在根据随机层级模型（RHM）的产生规则生成的字符串上训练扩散模型，发现由*公共子串*组成的样本被优先记忆。

sentences.en: This holds true even if the training data consists of entirely unique samples, indicating that deduplication at the data point level does not provide a meaningful privacy guarantee.
sentences.zh: 即使训练数据完全由唯一样本组成，这一点也成立，表明在数据点层面去重并不提供有意义的隐私保证。

sentences.en: Correspondingly we predict, then observe, delayed memorization for fat-tailed datasets (i.e., those with more atypical samples).
sentences.zh: 相应地，我们预测并随后观察到厚尾数据集（即包含更多非典型样本的数据集）的延迟记忆。

sentences.en: This effect is amplified when fat-tails are introduced into high-level production rules.
sentences.zh: 当厚尾被引入高层产生规则时，这一效应被放大。

sentences.en: These together suggest that *dataset diversity*, particularly at higher levels of abstraction, plays an important role in staving off memorization.
sentences.zh: 总之，这些表明*数据集多样性*，尤其是在更高抽象层面的多样性，在拖延记忆方面起重要作用。

sentences.en: Finally, we identify an intermediate regime of partial memorization in which common substrings are learned first and subsequently overproduced during generation.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们识别出一个部分记忆的中间区间，其中公共子串先被学习，随后在生成过程中被过度产生。

sentences.en: If training is stopped in this regime, models will exhibit the reversion-to-the-mean blandness often derided as "slop".
sentences.zh: 如果在此区间停止训练，模型将表现出常被讥讽为“slop”的回归均值平淡性。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Diffusion posterior sampling for simulation-based inference in tall data settings
title_zh: 大样本数据场景下基于仿真推断的扩散后验采样

sentences.en: Identifying the parameters of a non-linear model that best explain observed data is a core task across scientific fields.
sentences.zh: 识别最能解释观测数据的非线性模型的参数，是跨科学领域的核心任务。

sentences.en: When such models rely on complex simulators, evaluating the likelihood is typically intractable, making traditional inference methods such as MCMC inapplicable.
sentences.zh: 当此类模型依赖复杂模拟器时，评估似然通常是不可处理的，使 MCMC 等传统推断方法不适用。

sentences.en: Simulation-based inference (SBI) addresses this by training deep generative models to approximate the posterior distribution over parameters using simulated data.
sentences.zh: 基于模拟的推断（SBI）通过训练深度生成模型并使用模拟数据逼近参数上的后验分布来应对这一情况。

sentences.en: In this work, we consider the tall data setting, where multiple independent observations provide additional information, allowing sharper posteriors and improved parameter identifiability.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们考虑高数据量（tall data）设定，其中多个独立观测提供额外信息，允许更尖锐的后验与改进的参数可辨识性。

sentences.en: Building on the flourishing score-based diffusion literature, F-NPSE (Geffner et al., 2023) estimates the tall data posterior by composing individual scores from a neural network trained only for a single context observation.
sentences.zh: 在此蓬勃发展的基于分数的扩散文献基础上，F-NPSE（Geffner 等人，2023）通过组合仅针对单一上下文观测训练的神经网络的各个分数来估计高数据量后验。

sentences.en: This enables more flexible and simulation-efficient inference than alternative approaches for tall datasets in SBI.
sentences.zh: 这比 SBI 中高数据量数据集的替代方法实现更灵活、模拟更高效的推断。

sentences.en: However, it relies on costly Langevin dynamics during sampling.
sentences.zh: 然而，它在采样期间依赖昂贵的 Langevin 动力学。

sentences.en: We propose a new algorithm that eliminates the need for Langevin steps by explicitly approximating the diffusion process of the tall data posterior.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个新算法，通过显式逼近高数据量后验的扩散过程，消除了对 Langevin 步骤的需求。

sentences.en: Our method retains the advantages of compositional score-based inference while being significantly faster and more stable than F-NPSE.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法保留基于组合分数推断的优势，同时比 F-NPSE 显著更快、更稳定。

sentences.en: We demonstrate its improved performance on toy problems and standard SBI benchmarks, and showcase its scalability by applying it to a complex real-world model from computational neuroscience.
sentences.zh: 我们在玩具问题与标准 SBI 基准上展示其改进的性能，并通过将其应用于计算神经科学中一个复杂的真实世界模型来展示其可扩展性。

title_en: Diffusion-based learning framework for Constrained Nonconvex Optimization with Weighted Bootstrapped Refinement
title_zh: 结合加权自举细化的约束非凸优化扩散学习框架

sentences.en: Recent advances in diffusion models show promising potential to accelerate nonconvex problem solving by leveraging their multimodality.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型的近期进展显示出通过利用其多模态性加速非凸问题求解的有前景潜力。

sentences.en: However, most existing diffusion-based optimization approaches rely on supervised learning and lack a mechanism to enforce constraint satisfaction, which is required in real-world applications.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有的基于扩散的优化方法依赖监督学习，缺乏强制执行约束满足的机制，而这是现实应用中所要求的。

sentences.en: In that case, we investigate and theoretically analyze the inherent problem of supervised diffusion solvers and identify the distributional misalignment problem, i.e., the generated solution distribution often exhibits low probability mass on the feasible region.
sentences.zh: 在那种情况下，我们研究并从理论上分析监督扩散求解器的固有问题，识别出分布错位问题，即生成的解分布在可行区域上常常表现出较低的概率质量。

sentences.en: To resolve this issue, we propose DiOpt, a new diffusion-based learning framework for constrained nonconvex optimization, which effectively learns the mapping from noise to the constraint region.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 DiOpt，一个新的用于约束非凸优化的基于扩散学习框架，它有效地学习从噪声到约束区域的映射。

sentences.en: Specifically, this framework operates in two distinct phases: an initial warm-start phase, implemented via supervised learning, followed by a bootstrapping training phase.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，该框架在两个不同阶段运行：一个通过监督学习实现的初始预热启动阶段，随后是一个自助训练阶段。

sentences.en: This dual-phase architecture is designed to iteratively refine solutions, thereby improving the objective function with high constraint satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 这种双阶段架构旨在迭代精炼解，从而以高约束满足度改进目标函数。

sentences.en: Finally, we also employ a solution selection technique in inference for better optimality.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们还在推断中采用解选择技术以获得更好的最优性。

sentences.en: Notably, DiOpt is the first successful integration of the diffusion solver in constrained nonconvex optimization.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，DiOpt 是扩散求解器在约束非凸优化中首次成功的整合。

sentences.en: Evaluations on diverse nonconvex tasks demonstrate the superiority of DiOpt in both optimality and constraint satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 在多样非凸任务上的评估证明了 DiOpt 在最优性与约束满足方面的优越性。

sentences.en: Our official page is released at \url{https://dingsht.tech/diopt-webpage}.
sentences.zh: 我们的官方页面发布于 https://dingsht.tech/diopt-webpage。

authors.name: Xi Yao
authors.institution: China Mobile Communications Company Limited Research Institute

authors.name: Xiaoying Tang
authors.institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

title_en: DiL: Discrete-anchored Representation Alignment for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning
title_zh: DiL：用于半监督持续学习的离散锚定表征对齐

sentences.en: Leveraging the unlabeled stream is crucial yet challenging in Semi-Supervised Continual Learning (SSCL) under continual class expansion.
sentences.zh: 在持续类扩展下的半监督持续学习（SSCL）中，利用无标记流至关重要但充满挑战。

sentences.en: Existing SSCL methods typically enforce dense pseudo-label consistency and indiscriminate distillation on unlabeled data, which can reinforce errors and intensify base–novel interference.
sentences.zh: 现有的 SSCL 方法通常对无标记数据强制稠密伪标签一致性与无差别蒸馏，这可能强化错误并加剧基类-新类干扰。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose Discrete-anchored Incremental Learning (DiL) to ground continual updates on reliable discrete anchors that remain stable under noisy pseudo-labels.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出离散锚定增量学习（DiL），将持续更新立足于在含噪伪标签下保持稳定的可靠离散锚点。

sentences.en: DiL introduces Discrete Contrastive Distillation (DCD), which discretizes the distillation pathway and performs anchor-referenced selective distillation to curb error reinforcement.
sentences.zh: DiL 引入离散对比蒸馏（DCD），它离散化蒸馏路径并执行锚点参照的选择性蒸馏，以遏制错误强化。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Class-Aware Channel-Chunked Encoding (CACE) learns channel-chunked representations and exploits the confusion matrix induced by the discrete anchors to separate novel from confusable base classes.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，类别感知通道分块编码（CACE）学习通道分块表示，并利用由离散锚点诱导的混淆矩阵将新类与可混淆的基类分离。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple datasets show that DiL achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse SSCL protocols.
sentences.zh: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，DiL 在多样 SSCL 协议上取得了最先进的性能。

authors.name: Jinxiang Lai
authors.institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: DiLA: Disentangled Latent Action World Models
title_zh: DiLA：解耦潜在动作世界模型

sentences.en: Latent Action Models (LAMs) enable the learning of world models from unlabeled video by inferring abstract actions between consecutive frames.
sentences.zh: 潜在动作模型（LAM）通过在连续帧之间推断抽象动作，支持从无标记视频学习世界模型。

sentences.en: However, LAMs face a fundamental trade-off between action abstraction and generation fidelity.
sentences.zh: 然而，LAM 面临动作抽象与生成保真度之间的基本权衡。

sentences.en: Existing methods typically circumvent this issue by using two-stage training with pre-trained world models or by limiting predictions to optical flow.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常通过使用预训练世界模型的两阶段训练或将预测限于光流来规避这一问题。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce *DiLA*, a novel **Di**sentangled **L**atent **A**ction world model that aims to resolve this trade-off via content-structure disentanglement.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入 *DiLA*，一个新颖的**解**耦潜在动作世界模型，旨在通过内容-结构解耦解决这一权衡。

sentences.en: Our key insight is that disentanglement and latent action learning are co-evolving: the predictive bottleneck inherent in latent action learning serves as a driving force for disentanglement, compelling the model to distill spatial layouts into the structure pathway while offloading visual details to a separate content pathway for generation.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是解耦与潜在动作学习是共同演化的：潜在动作学习中固有的预测瓶颈充当解耦的驱动力，迫使模型将空间布局蒸馏进结构通路，同时将视觉细节卸载到用于生成的独立内容通路。

sentences.en: This synergy yields a continuous, semantically structured latent action space without compromising generative quality.
sentences.zh: 这种协同产生一个连续的、语义结构化的潜在动作空间，而不损害生成质量。

sentences.en: *DiLA* achieves superior results in video generation quality, action transfer, visual planning, and manifold interpretability.
sentences.zh: *DiLA* 在视频生成质量、动作迁移、视觉规划与流形可解释性方面取得优异结果。

sentences.en: These findings establish *DiLA* as a unified framework that simultaneously achieves high-level action abstraction and high-fidelity generation, advancing the frontier of self-supervised world model learning.
sentences.zh: 这些发现确立了 *DiLA* 作为一个同时实现高层动作抽象与高保真生成的统一框架，推进了自监督世界模型学习的前沿。

title_en: Dimension-free convergence of diffusion models for approximate Gaussian mixtures
title_zh: 近似高斯混合的扩散模型中不依赖维度的收敛性

sentences.en: Diffusion models are distinguished by their exceptional generative performance, particularly in producing high-quality samples through iterative denoising.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型以其非凡的生成性能而著称，尤其是在通过迭代去噪生成高质量样本方面。

sentences.en: While current theory suggests that the number of denoising steps required for accurate sample generation should scale linearly with data dimension, this does not reflect the practical efficiency of widely used algorithms like Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs).
sentences.zh: 虽然当前理论表明，准确样本生成所需的去噪步数应随数据维度线性扩展，但这并未反映诸如去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）等广泛使用算法的实际效率。

sentences.en: This paper investigates the effectiveness of diffusion models in sampling complex high-dimensional distributions that can be well-approximated by Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs).
sentences.zh: 本文研究扩散模型在采样可以被高斯混合模型（GMM）良好逼近的复杂高维分布方面的有效性。

sentences.en: For these distributions, our main result shows that DDPM takes at most $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)$ iterations to attain an $\varepsilon$-accurate distribution in total variation (TV) distance, independent of both the ambient dimension $d$ and the number of components $K$, up to logarithmic factors.
sentences.zh: 对于这些分布，我们的主要结果表明，DDPM 至多需要 $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)$ 次迭代即可在总变分（TV）距离下达到 $\varepsilon$-精确分布，与环境的维度 d 与分量数 K 都无关（直至对数因子）。

sentences.en: Furthermore, this result remains robust to score estimation errors.
sentences.zh: 此外，这一结果对分数估计误差保持稳健。

sentences.en: These findings highlight the remarkable effectiveness of diffusion models in high-dimensional settings given the universal approximation capability of GMMs, and provide theoretical insights into their practical success.
sentences.zh: 鉴于 GMM 的普遍逼近能力，这些发现凸显了扩散模型在高维情境中的卓著有效性，并为其实际成功提供了理论洞见。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Dimension-Free Multimodal Sampling via Preconditioned Annealed Langevin Dynamics
title_zh: 通过预条件退火 Langevin 动力学实现维度无关的多峰采样

sentences.en: Designing sampling algorithms for multimodal targets that remain stable under refinement of the finite-dimensional approximation of an underlying function-space problem is a central challenge.
sentences.zh: 为多模态目标设计采样算法，使其在底层函数空间问题有限维近似的精化下保持稳定，是一个核心挑战。

sentences.en: Annealed Langevin dynamics (ALD) is a natural alternative to classical Langevin in this context, since it is often observed to improve exploration across modes.
sentences.zh: 退火 Langevin 动力学（ALD）在此语境中是经典 Langevin 的自然替代，因为人们常常观察到它改善跨模态探索。

sentences.en: Yet a gap remains between its empirical success and existing theory: under which conditions can ALD be guaranteed to remain stable across dimensions?
sentences.zh: 然而，其经验成功与现有理论之间仍有差距：ALD 在何种条件下能被保证跨维度保持稳定？

sentences.en: In this paper, we bridge this gap by providing a uniform-in-dimension analysis of continuous-time ALD for Gaussian-mixture targets.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过为高斯混合目标的连续时间 ALD 提供随维度一致的（uniform-in-dimension）分析来弥合这一差距。

sentences.en: Along an explicit annealing path obtained by gradually removing Gaussian smoothing from the target, we identify spectral conditions linking the smoothing covariance to the component covariances under which ALD achieves a prescribed accuracy in Kullback-Leibler divergence within a dimension-uniform time horizon.
sentences.zh: 沿着一条通过逐步移除目标上的高斯平滑而获得的显式退火路径，我们识别出将平滑协方差与分量协方差联系起来的谱条件，在这些条件下 ALD 在随维度一致的时间视界内于 Kullback-Leibler 散度达到指定准确率。

sentences.en: We then establish stability in a perturbative regime with imperfect initialization and approximate scores.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们在具有不完美初始化与近似分数的扰动区间内确立稳定性。

sentences.en: Under a misspecified-mixture score model, we show that preconditioning ALD with an operator whose spectrum decays sufficiently fast prevents error terms from accumulating across coordinates and thereby preserves dimension-uniform control.
sentences.zh: 在误设混合分数模型下，我们表明用谱充分快速衰减的算子对 ALD 进行预条件，可以防止误差项跨坐标累积，从而保持随维度一致的控制。

title_en: Dimension-Independent Convergence of Underdamped Langevin Monte Carlo in KL Divergence
title_zh: 欠阻尼 Langevin 蒙特卡洛在 KL 散度下的维度无关收敛性

sentences.en: Underdamped Langevin dynamics (ULD) is a widely-used sampler for Gibbs distributions $\pi\propto e^{-V}$, and is often empirically effective in high dimensions.
sentences.zh: 阻尼 Langevin 动力学（ULD）是 Gibbs 分布 $\pi\propto e^{-V}$ 的广泛使用的采样器，并且常常在高维度下经验有效。

sentences.en: However, existing non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for discretized ULD typically scale polynomially with the ambient dimension $d$, leading to vacuous bounds when $d$ is large.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的离散化 ULD 非渐近收敛保证通常随环境维度 d 多项式增长，当 d 很大时会给出空洞的界。

sentences.en: The main known dimension-free result concerns the randomized midpoint discretization in Wasserstein-2 distance (Liu et al., 2023), while dimension-independent guarantees for ULD discretizations in KL divergence have remained open.
sentences.zh: 已知的主要无维度结果涉及 Wasserstein-2 距离中的随机中点离散化（Liu 等人，2023），而 KL 散度下 ULD 离散化的维度无关保证仍悬而未决。

sentences.en: We close this gap by proving the first dimension-free KL divergence bounds for discretized ULD.
sentences.zh: 我们通过证明离散化 ULD 的首个无维度 KL 散度界来填补这一空白。

sentences.en: Our analysis refines the KL local error framework (Altschuler et al., 2025) to a dimension-free setting and yields bounds that depend on $\mathrm{tr}(\mathbf{H})$, where $\mathbf{H}$ upper bounds the Hessian of $V$, rather than on $d$.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析将 KL 局部误差框架（Altschuler 等人，2025）精炼到无维度情境，并产生取决于 $\mathrm{tr}(\mathbf{H})$（其中 $\mathbf{H}$ 约束 V 的 Hessian 的上界）而非 d 的界。

sentences.en: As a consequence, we obtain improved iteration complexity for underdamped Langevin Monte Carlo relative to overdamped Langevin methods in regimes where $\mathrm{tr}(\mathbf{H})\ll d$.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在 $\mathrm{tr}(\mathbf{H})\ll d$ 的区间内，相对于过阻尼 Langevin 方法获得阻尼 Langevin 蒙特卡洛改进的迭代复杂度。

title_en: Dimensional Collapse in Transformer Attention Outputs: A Challenge for Sparse Dictionary Learning
title_zh: Transformer 注意力输出的维度坍缩：稀疏字典学习的挑战

sentences.en: Transformer architectures, and their attention mechanisms in particular, form the foundation of modern large language models.
sentences.zh: Transformer 架构，尤其是其注意力机制，构成了现代大语言模型的基础。

sentences.en: While transformer models are widely believed to operate in high-dimensional hidden spaces, we show that attention outputs are confined to a surprisingly low-dimensional subspace, with an effective dimensionality of only about 60\% of the full space---a phenomenon that is consistently observed across diverse model families and datasets, and arises from overlap among the output subspaces of different attention heads.
sentences.zh: 虽然 Transformer 模型被广泛认为在高维隐藏空间中运作，但我们表明注意力输出被限制在一个令人惊讶的低维子空间中，有效维度仅为全空间的约 60\%——这一现象在不同模型家族与数据集上被一致观察到，源于不同注意力头的输出子空间之间的重叠。

sentences.en: Critically, we find this low-rank structure as a key factor of the prevalent dead feature problem in sparse dictionary learning, where it creates a mismatch between randomly initialized features and the intrinsic geometry of the activation space.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，我们发现这种低秩结构是稀疏字典学习中普遍存在的死特征问题的关键因素，它造成随机初始化特征与激活空间内在几何之间的不匹配。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose a subspace-constrained training method for sparse autoencoders (SAEs), initializing feature directions into the active subspace of activations.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出一种用于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的子空间约束训练方法，将特征方向初始化到激活的活动子空间中。

sentences.en: Our approach reduces dead features from 87\% to below 1\% in Attention Output SAEs with 1M features, and can further extend to other sparse dictionary learning methods.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法在具有 1M 特征的注意力输出 SAE 中将死特征从 87\% 减少到 1\% 以下，并且可以进一步扩展到其他稀疏字典学习方法。

sentences.en: Our findings provide both new insights into the geometry of attention and practical tools for improving sparse dictionary learning in large language models.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现既提供了对注意力几何的新洞见，也提供了改进大语言模型中稀疏字典学习的实用工具。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/OpenMOSS/Llamascopium}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/OpenMOSS/Llamascopium 获取。

topic: General Machine Learning->Unsupervised and Semi-supervised Learning
title_en: Dimensionality Reduction with Point-distributions Similarity Invariant
title_zh: 保持点–分布相似性不变的降维

sentences.en: Existing dimensionality reduction methods all perform dimensionality reduction by preserving some invariant in the space before and after dimensionality reduction.
sentences.zh: 现有的降维方法都通过在降维前后的空间中保持某个不变量来执行降维。

sentences.en: This paper proposes a new dimensionality reduction invariant: preserving the invariant of the point-distributions similarity.
sentences.zh: 本文提出一种新的降维不变量：保持点分布相似性的不变量。

sentences.en: We also design a linear and efficient method to achieve dimensionality reduction while preserving this invariant.
sentences.zh: 我们还设计一种线性且高效的方法，在保持该不变量的同时实现降维。

sentences.en: We theoretically prove the feasibility of our method for dimensionality reduction.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上证明我们方法用于降维的可行性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, our results on benchmark datasets and single-cell expression data demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们在基准数据集与单细胞表达数据上的结果展示了所提出方法的有效性与效率。

title_en: DiP-G: Discrete Prompting for Graph Neural Networks
title_zh: DiP-G：图神经网络的离散提示

sentences.en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are increasingly adopting the "pre-training, adaptation" paradigm, which first pre-train GNNs on large-scale unlabeled graph data and then adapt them to specific downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络（GNN）正日益采用“预训练、适配”范式，它首先在大规模无标记图数据上预训练 GNN，然后将它们适配到特定下游任务。

sentences.en: As a common pattern, graph prompting adapts to the frozen encoder by modifying the input graph structure, rather than fine-tuning the model parameters.
sentences.zh: 作为一种常见模式，图提示通过修改输入图结构而非微调模型参数来适配冻结的编码器。

sentences.en: However, most existing graph prompting approaches optimize the continuous and weighted adjacency structure in the adaptation phase, while requiring a hard discretization at inference time.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有的图提示方法在适配阶段优化连续且加权的邻接结构，而在推理时要求硬离散化。

sentences.en: This difference causes a train-test mismatch which is particularly harmful in few-shot regimes.
sentences.zh: 这种差异造成训练-测试不匹配，在少样本区间尤其有害。

sentences.en: To address the issue, we propose **Di**screte **P**rompting for **G**raphs, a discrete prompting framework that directly learns task-specific topology prompts in the combinatorial space.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出**图离散提示**，一个在组合空间中直接学习任务特定拓扑提示的离散提示框架。

sentences.en: DiP-G operates on multi-hop local candidate subgraphs to ensure scalability, generates hard (k)-sparse prompts through a perturbed Top-(k) solver, and optimizes the  discrete structures using an I-MLE gradient estimator.
sentences.zh: DiP-G 在多重跳的局部候选子图上运行以确保可扩展性，通过扰动 Top-k 求解器生成硬 (k) 稀疏提示，并使用 I-MLE 梯度估计器优化离散结构。

sentences.en: To improve the efficiency of backward pass, we further introduce an adaptive active-set screening rule that accelerates the target solve and can provably maintain the accuracy of the solution.
sentences.zh: 为提高反向传播的效率，我们进一步引入一个自适应活动集筛选规则，它加快目标求解并可证明地保持解的准确率。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments conducted on multiple benchmark datasets have validated the effectiveness of our proposed method.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准数据集上进行的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。

title_en: Direct 3D-Aware Object Insertion via Decomposed Visual Proxies
title_zh: 通过分解式视觉代理直接实现三维感知物体插入

sentences.en: Object insertion aims to seamlessly composite a reference object into a specified region of a background image.
sentences.zh: 对象插入旨在将参考对象无缝合成到背景图像的指定区域中。

sentences.en: Recent diffusion-based methods achieve high visual quality but formulate insertion as a simple 2D inpainting task, providing no explicit control over the object's 3D pose and limiting their practical applicability.
sentences.zh: 近期的基于扩散方法实现了高视觉质量，但将插入表述为简单的 2D 修复任务，对对象的 3D 姿态没有显式控制，限制了它们的实际适用性。

sentences.en: We propose **DIRECT** (**D**ecomposed **I**njection for **RE**ference **C**omposition and **T**arget-integration), a novel framework that integrates interactive pose manipulation with high-fidelity 2D image synthesis to enable pose-controllable object insertion.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **DIRECT**（参考合成与目标整合的分解式注入），一个将交互式姿态操作与高保真 2D 图像合成相结合、实现姿态可控对象插入的新颖框架。

sentences.en: Our method decomposes the insertion conditions into three complementary components: appearance guidance capturing visual details from the reference object, geometry guidance derived from the user-adjusted 3D proxy, and context guidance from the target background.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法将插入条件分解为三个互补组件：从参考对象捕获视觉细节的外观引导、从用户调整的 3D 代理导出的几何引导，以及来自目标背景的上下文引导。

sentences.en: By injecting them through separate pathways, DIRECT avoids feature entanglement and simultaneously preserves reference appearance, follows the user-specified pose, and adapts the object to the target scene.
sentences.zh: 通过独立通路注入它们，DIRECT 避免特征纠缠，同时保留参考外观、遵循用户指定的姿态并将对象适配到目标场景。

sentences.en: We also introduce an automated data construction pipeline to improve the diversity and quality of training data.
sentences.zh: 我们还引入一个自动化数据构建流水线，以改善训练数据的多样性与质量。

sentences.en: Experiments show that DIRECT outperforms previous methods in both geometric controllability and visual quality.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，DIRECT 在几何可控性与视觉质量两方面都优于先前方法。

title_en: Direct Flow Q-Learning
title_zh: 直接流 Q 学习

sentences.en: Flow Matching shows great promise in offline reinforcement learning (RL), yet optimizing these iterative policies via Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT) is unstable.
sentences.zh: 流匹配在离线强化学习（RL）中展现出巨大前景，然而通过时间反向传播（BPTT）优化这些迭代策略是不稳定的。

sentences.en: While prevailing paradigms circumvent this by distilling multi-step flows into single-step approximations, such methods may limit the benefits of iterative refinement.
sentences.zh: 虽然主流范式通过将多步流蒸馏进单步近似来规避这一问题，但此类方法可能限制迭代精炼的好处。

sentences.en: To avoid these sacrifices, we propose Direct Flow Q-Learning (DFQL), a streamlined framework that attains superior results by optimizing flow matching policies without BPTT or distillation.
sentences.zh: 为避免这些牺牲，我们提出直接流 Q 学习（DFQL），一个简洁的框架，它无需 BPTT 或蒸馏即可通过优化流匹配策略获得优越结果。

sentences.en: DFQL derives a surrogate objective that directly injects terminal Q-value gradients as a guidance term into each step velocity field, ensuring stable optimization while preserving iterative expressive capacity.
sentences.zh: DFQL 推导出一个替代目标，它将终端 Q 值梯度作为引导项直接注入每个步骤的速率场，确保稳定优化，同时保留迭代表达能力。

sentences.en: Across 73 challenging tasks in OGBench and D4RL, DFQL achieves state-of-the-art results.
sentences.zh: 在 OGBench 与 D4RL 的 73 个挑战性任务中，DFQL 取得了最先进的结果。

sentences.en: Additionally, DFQL extends seamlessly to the offline-to-online setting, delivering substantial performance gains without further modification.
sentences.zh: 此外，DFQL 无缝扩展到离线到在线情境，无需进一步修改即可带来实质性性能增益。

title_en: DirectEdit: Step-Level Accurate Inversion for Flow-Based Image Editing
title_zh: DirectEdit：用于基于流的图像编辑的步级精确反演

sentences.en: With recent advancements in large-scale pre-trained text-to-image (T2I) models, training-free image editing methods have demonstrated remarkable success.
sentences.zh: 随着大规模预训练文生图（T2I）模型的近期进展，免训练的图像编辑方法已展现出显著成功。

sentences.en: Typically, these methods involve adding noise to a clean image via an inversion process, followed by separate denoising steps for the reconstruction and editing paths during the forward process.
sentences.zh: 通常，这些方法涉及通过反演过程向干净图像添加噪声，随后在前向过程中为重建与编辑路径进行单独的去噪步骤。

sentences.en: However, since the reconstruction path is approximated using noisy latents from mismatched timesteps, existing methods inevitably suffer from accumulated drift, which fundamentally limits reconstruction fidelity.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于重建路径使用来自不匹配时间步的含噪潜在变量近似，现有方法不可避免地遭受累积漂移，这从根本上限制了重建保真度。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we systematically analyze the inversion process within the flow transformer and propose DirectEdit, a simple yet effective editing method that eliminates the inherent reconstruction error without introducing additional neural function evaluations (NFEs).
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们系统性分析流 Transformer 中的反演过程，并提出 DirectEdit，一种简单而有效的编辑方法，它在不引入额外神经函数评估（NFE）的情况下消除固有的重建误差。

sentences.en: Unlike most prior works that attempt to rectify the inversion path, DirectEdit focuses on directly aligning the forward paths, enabling precise reconstruction and reliable feature sharing.
sentences.zh: 与大多数试图校正反演路径的先前工作不同，DirectEdit 专注于直接对齐前向路径，实现精确重建与可靠的特征共享。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a preservation mechanism based on attention feature injection and multi-branch mask-guided noise blending, which effectively balances fidelity and editability.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一个基于注意力特征注入与多分支掩码引导噪声混合的保留机制，有效平衡保真度与可编辑性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse scenarios demonstrate that DirectEdit achieves efficient and accurate image editing, delivering superior performance that outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
sentences.zh: 跨多样场景的大量实验表明，DirectEdit 实现高效准确的图像编辑，提供超越最先进方法的卓越性能。

sentences.en: Code and examples are available at https://desongyang.github.io/Directedit.
sentences.zh: 代码与示例可在 https://desongyang.github.io/Directedit 获取。

title_en: Directional Neural Collapse Explains Few-Shot Transfer in Self-Supervised Learning
title_zh: 方向性神经坍缩解释自监督学习中的少样本迁移

sentences.en: Frozen self-supervised representations often transfer well with only a few labels across many semantic tasks.
sentences.zh: 冻结的自监督表示常常仅用少量标签即可在众多语义任务上良好迁移。

sentences.en: We argue that a single geometric quantity, *directional* CDNV (decision-axis variance), sits at the core of two favorable behaviors: strong few-shot transfer within a task, and low interference across many tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，单个几何量——*方向性* CDNV（决策轴方差）——处于两种有利行为的核心：任务内强的少样本迁移，以及跨众多任务低的干扰。

sentences.en: We show that both emerge when variability *along* class-separating directions is small.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，当沿类分离方向的可变性较小时，两者都会出现。

sentences.en: First, we prove sharp non-asymptotic multiclass generalization bounds for downstream classification whose leading term is the directional CDNV.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们证明下游分类的锐利非渐近多类泛化界，其首项是方向性 CDNV。

sentences.en: The bounds include finite-shot corrections that cleanly separate intrinsic decision-axis variability from centroid-estimation error.
sentences.zh: 这些界包含有限样本修正，清晰地将内在决策轴可变性与质心估计误差分开。

sentences.en: Second, we link decision-axis collapse to multitask geometry: for independent balanced labelings, small directional CDNV across tasks forces the corresponding decision axes to be nearly orthogonal, helping a single representation support many tasks with minimal interference.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们将决策轴坍缩与多任务几何联系起来：对于独立的均衡标注，跨任务的小方向性 CDNV 迫使相应决策轴近乎正交，帮助单一表示以最小干扰支持众多任务。

sentences.en: Empirically, across SSL objectives, directional CDNV collapses during pretraining even when classical CDNV remains large, and our bounds closely track few-shot error at practical shot sizes.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，跨 SSL 目标，即使在经典 CDNV 仍然很大时，方向性 CDNV 也在预训练期间坍缩，并且我们的界在实际样本量下紧密跟踪少样本误差。

sentences.en: Additionally, on synthetic multitask data, we verify that SSL learns representations whose induced decision axes are nearly orthogonal.
sentences.zh: 此外，在合成多任务数据上，我们验证 SSL 学到的表示所诱导的决策轴近乎正交。

title_en: Directly Optimizing Natural Language Explanations for Behavioral Faithfulness: Simulatability and Recoverability
title_zh: 直接优化自然语言解释的行为忠实性：可模拟性与可恢复性

sentences.en: Natural-language explanations are widely used to interpret machine learning models, yet many prioritize human plausibility over accurately reflecting or predicting model behavior.
sentences.zh: 自然语言解释被广泛用于解释机器学习模型，然而许多解释优先考虑人类合理性，而非准确反映或预测模型行为。

sentences.en: Prior approaches often rely on human-written rationales, producing post-hoc explanations that neither align with the model’s decision function nor generalize.
sentences.zh: 先前方法常常依赖人类编写的理由，产生既不与模型决策功能一致、也不泛化的事后解释。

sentences.en: We introduce $\textbf{OPeX}$, a natural-language explanation model that directly optimizes for behavioral faithfulness: the ability of an explanation to reflect and predict a model’s observable input–output behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 \textbf{OPeX}，一个直接优化行为忠实性（解释反映并预测模型可观察输入-输出行为的能力）的自然语言解释模型。

sentences.en: $\textbf{OPeX}$ is trained using reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), optimizing two complementary metrics: recoverability, which measures whether explanations recover model predictions on seen examples, and simulatability, which measures prediction of model behavior on unseen inputs.
sentences.zh: \textbf{OPeX} 使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习训练，优化两个互补指标：可恢复性（衡量解释是否在已见示例上恢复模型预测）与可模拟性（衡量对未见输入上模型行为的预测）。

sentences.en: Across structured and text-based tasks, $\textbf{OPeX}$ achieves high simulatability (∼0.85) and recoverability (∼0.99), outperforming GPT-4o, LLaMA-3.3-70B, MaNtLE, Chain-of-Thought (CoT)-based models, and human-written explanations, despite using an 8B-parameter backbone.
sentences.zh: 在结构化与基于文本的任务上，\textbf{OPeX} 实现了高可模拟性（约 0.85）与可恢复性（约 0.99），超越 GPT-4o、LLaMA-3.3-70B、MaNtLE、基于思维链（CoT）的模型以及人类编写的解释，尽管仅使用 8B 参数主干。

sentences.en: Human user studies show a 15% improvement in classification accuracy over competent baselines.
sentences.zh: 人类用户研究表明，与胜任的基线相比，分类准确率提高 15%。

title_en: Dirichlet-Prior Shaping: Guiding Expert Specialization in Upcycled MoEs
title_zh: 狄利克雷先验塑形：引导升级再造混合专家模型的专家专门化

sentences.en: Upcycling pre-trained dense models into sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) efficiently increases model capacity but often suffers from poor expert specialization due to naive weight replication.
sentences.zh: 将预训练稠密模型升级为稀疏混合专家（MoE）高效地增加模型容量，但由于朴素权重复制，常常遭受专家特化不佳之苦。

sentences.en: We introduce Dirichlet-Prior Shaping Loss (DPSL), a novel router regularization technique that directly shapes routing probability distributions by matching expert assignments to a target Dirichlet prior resulting in enhanced expert specialization.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 Dirichlet 先验塑形损失（DPSL），一种新颖的路由器正则化技术，它通过将专家分配与目标 Dirichlet 先验匹配直接塑形路由概率分布，从而增强专家特化。

sentences.en: DPSL enables encoding of inductive biases such as encouraging experts to focus on specific modalities or tasks, without requiring manual intervention.
sentences.zh: DPSL 支持编码归纳偏差，例如鼓励专家聚焦特定模态或任务，而无需手动干预。

sentences.en: DPSL is a general tool applicable to any module that outputs categorical probability distributions, extending its utility beyond MoE training.
sentences.zh: DPSL 是一个通用工具，适用于任何输出类别概率分布的模块，将其效用扩展到 MoE 训练之外。

sentences.en: Experiments on upcycled MoE vision-language models show that DPSL consistently outperforms upcycling strategies and regularization techniques across standard vision-language benchmarks, addressing the critical issue of poor specialization and fostering higher-performing models.
sentences.zh: 在升级 MoE 视觉语言模型上的实验表明，DPSL 在标准视觉语言基准上一致地优于升级策略与正则化技术，解决了特化不佳的关键问题并催生更高性能的模型。

title_en: DISCO: Mitigating Bias in Deep Learning with Conditional Distance Correlation
title_zh: DISCO：利用条件距离相关性缓解深度学习偏差

sentences.en: Dataset bias often leads deep learning models to exploit spurious correlations instead of task-relevant signals.
sentences.zh: 数据集偏差常常导致深度学习模型利用虚假相关而非任务相关信号。

sentences.en: We introduce the Standard Anti-Causal Model (SAM), a unifying causal framework that characterizes bias mechanisms and yields a conditional independence criterion for causal stability.
sentences.zh: 我们引入标准反因果模型（SAM），一个统一因果框架，它刻画偏差机制并产生因果稳定性的条件独立准则。

sentences.en: Building on this theory, we propose DISCO$_m$ and sDISCO, efficient and scalable estimators of conditional distance correlation that enable independence regularization in black-box models.
sentences.zh: 在此理论基础上，我们提出 DISCO$_m$ 与 sDISCO，条件距离相关的高效可扩展估计器，支持黑盒模型中的独立正则化。

sentences.en: Across six diverse datasets, our methods consistently outperform or are competitive in existing bias mitigation approaches, while requiring fewer hyperparameters and scaling seamlessly to multi-bias scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在六个多样数据集上，我们的方法一致超越或与现有的偏差缓解方法竞争，同时需要更少的超参数并无缝扩展到多偏差场景。

sentences.en: This work bridges causal theory and practical deep learning, providing both a principled foundation and effective tools for robust prediction.
sentences.zh: 本工作在因果理论与实践深度学习之间架起桥梁，为稳健预测提供了有原则的基础与有效的工具。

title_en: DiscoForcing: A Unified Framework for Real-Time Audio-Driven Character Control with Diffusion Forcing
title_zh: DiscoForcing：利用扩散强制实现实时音频驱动角色控制的统一框架

sentences.en: We study real-time audio-responsive character control as a deployment-faithful problem: strictly causal, bounded-latency streaming that must generate coherent full-body motion at interactive frame rates while the audio condition can change abruptly (tempo shifts, drops, or user edits).
sentences.zh: 我们将实时音频响应角色控制作为部署忠实的问题来研究：严格因果、有界延迟的流式处理，必须在此前生成连贯的全身运动，而音频条件可以突然变化（节奏转换、丢失或用户编辑）。

sentences.en: Prior music-to-motion systems are largely optimized for offline generation with global context, and degrade in streaming rollouts where conditioning history becomes stale or unreliable.
sentences.zh: 先前的音乐到动作系统主要针对具有全局上下文的离线生成进行优化，并在条件历史变得过时或不可靠的流式 rollout 中退化。

sentences.en: We introduce DiscoForcing, a streaming audio-driven diffusion framework that combines a causal music encoder that captures rhythmic structure and phase dynamics with a diffusion-forcing sequence model trained under heterogeneous noise levels across the temporal horizon.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 DiscoForcing，一个流式音频驱动扩散框架，它将捕获节奏结构与相位动力学的因果音乐编码器，与在时间视界上以异质噪声水平训练的扩散强制序列模型相结合。

sentences.en: Building on this, we design a hybrid temporal schedule and a history-guided streaming sampler to explicitly trade off responsiveness against long-horizon consistency under non-stationary audio.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们设计一个混合时间调度与历史引导的流式采样器，以显式地在非平稳音频下权衡响应性与长视界一致性。

sentences.en: Implemented in an end-to-end real-time interactive system with online avatar playback and humanoid deployment workflows, DiscoForcing delivers more stable long-horizon rollouts and sharper audio–motion alignment than prior baselines under matched causality and latency constraints while maintaining real-time throughput.
sentences.zh: 在端到端实时交互系统（带有在线化身播放与人形部署工作流）中实现，在匹配的因果性与延迟约束下，DiscoForcing 比先前基线提供更稳定的长视界 rollout 与更锐利的音频-动作对齐，同时保持实时吞吐量。

sentences.en: Project Page: https://discoforcing.github.io
sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://discoforcing.github.io

title_en: DiScoFormer: Plug-In Density and Score Estimation with Transformers
title_zh: DiScoFormer：利用 Transformer 进行插件式密度与得分估计

sentences.en: Estimating probability density and its score from samples remains a core problem in generative modeling, Bayesian inference, and kinetic theory.
sentences.zh: 从样本估计概率密度及其分数，仍是生成建模、贝叶斯推断与动力学理论中的核心问题。

sentences.en: Existing methods are bifurcated: classical kernel density estimators (KDE) generalize across distributions but suffer from the curse of dimensionality, while modern neural score models achieve high precision but require retraining for every target distribution.
sentences.zh: 现有方法呈两极化：经典核密度估计（KDE）可跨分布泛化但遭受维度灾难，而现代神经分数模型实现高精度但需要对每个目标分布重新训练。

sentences.en: We introduce DiScoFormer (Density and Score Transformer), a ``train-once, infer-anywhere" equivariant Transformer that maps i.i.d. samples to both density values and score vectors, generalizing across distributions and sample sizes.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 DiScoFormer（密度与分数 Transformer），一个“一次训练，随处推断”的等变 Transformer，它将 i.i.d. 样本映射到密度值与分数向量两者，跨分布与样本量泛化。

sentences.en: Analytically, we prove that self-attention can recover normalized KDE, establishing it as a functional generalization of kernel methods; empirically, individual attention heads learn multi-scale, kernel-like behaviors.
sentences.zh: 在解析上，我们证明自注意力可以恢复归一化 KDE，将其确立为核方法的函数推广；在经验上，个体注意力头学习多尺度、类核的行为。

sentences.en: The model converges faster and achieves higher precision than KDE for density estimation, and provides a high-fidelity plug-in score oracle for score-debiased KDE, Fisher information computation, and Fokker-Planck-type PDEs.
sentences.zh: 该模型在密度估计上比 KDE 收敛更快并实现更高精度，并为分数去偏 KDE、Fisher 信息计算与 Fokker-Planck 型 PDE 提供高保真即插即用的分数预言机。

title_en: Discontinuous Galerkin Neural Operator for Pathology Defocus Deblurring
title_zh: 用于病理图像离焦去模糊的间断 Galerkin 神经算子

sentences.en: Defocus deblurring in pathological microscopy remains challenging due to the spatially varying and locally discontinuous nature of optical blur induced by a position-dependent integral imaging process.
sentences.zh: 病理显微镜中的失焦去模糊因位置相关积分成像过程所诱导的光学模糊具空间变化与局部不连续性质而仍然充满挑战。

sentences.en: Existing deep learning methods, constrained by shift-invariance assumptions and limited interpretability, are not well suited to such heterogeneous blur patterns.
sentences.zh: 受位移不变假设与有限可解释性约束的现有深度学习方法，不太适合此类异质模糊模式。

sentences.en: Neural operators provide a principled alternative by modeling defocus formation directly as an integral operator, offering a new perspective on defocus deblurring.
sentences.zh: 神经算子通过将失焦形成直接建模为积分算子提供有原则的替代方案，为失焦去模糊提供新视角。

sentences.en: However, most existing neural operator architectures for low-level vision rely on globally parameterized kernels that assume smoothness and stationarity, limiting their ability to model heterogeneous and locally discontinuous blur patterns.
sentences.zh: 然而，用于底层视觉的大多数现有神经算子架构依赖假设平滑性与平稳性的全局参数化核，限制了它们建模异质与局部不连续模糊模式的能力。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose the Discontinuous Galerkin Neural Operator (DGNO), which parameterizes the integral kernel using a discontinuous Galerkin formulation with element-local volume operators and interface numerical fluxes.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出不连续 Galerkin 神经算子（DGNO），它使用具有元素局部体积算子与界面数值通量的不连续 Galerkin 表述参数化积分核。

sentences.en: DGNO provides a principled combination of locality,   heterogeneity modeling, and global coherence while preserving the underlying physics   of optical image formation.
sentences.zh: DGNO 在保留光学图像形成的底层物理的同时，提供局部性、异质性建模与全局连贯性的有原则组合。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that DGNO surpasses state-of-the-art methods, delivering sharper reconstructions, robust handling of spatially varying blur, and scalable high-resolution performance.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，DGNO 超越最先进方法，提供更锐利的重建、对空间变化模糊的稳健处理以及可扩展的高分辨率性能。

title_en: Discounted Beta–Bernoulli Reward Estimation for Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
title_zh: 折扣 Beta–Bernoulli 奖励估计：实现样本高效的可验证奖励强化学习

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models.
sentences.zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为改善大语言模型推理能力的有效后训练范式。

sentences.en: However, existing group-based RLVR methods often suffer from severe sample inefficiency.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的基于分组的 RLVR 方法常常遭受严重样本低效之苦。

sentences.en: This inefficiency stems from reliance on point estimation of rewards from a small number of rollouts, leading to high estimation variance, variance collapse, and ineffective utilization of generated responses.
sentences.zh: 这种低效源于依赖从少量 rollout 对奖励进行点估计，导致高估计方差、方差坍缩以及生成响应的低效利用。

sentences.en: In this work, we reformulate RLVR from a statistical estimation perspective by modeling rewards as samples drawn from a policy-induced distribution and casting advantage computation as the problem of estimating the reward distribution from finite data.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们从统计估计视角重新表述 RLVR，将奖励建模为从策略诱导分布中抽取的样本，并将优势计算投射为从有限数据估计奖励分布的问题。

sentences.en: Building on this view, we propose **D**iscounted **B**eta–**B**ernoulli (**DBB**) reward estimation, which leverages historical reward statistics for the non-stationary distribution.
sentences.zh: 基于这一视角，我们提出**折**扣 **B**eta-**B**ernoulli（**DBB**）奖励估计，它为时变非平稳分布利用历史奖励统计量。

sentences.en: Although biased, the resulting estimator exhibits reduced and stable variance and theoretically avoids variance collapse.
sentences.zh: 尽管有偏，所得估计器展现出降低且稳定的方差，并在理论上避免方差坍缩。

sentences.en: Under mild non-stationarity, it also achieves a lower mean squared error than standard point estimation, as we characterize analytically and verify empirically.
sentences.zh: 在温和非平稳性下，它还实现了比标准点估计更低的均方误差，我们对此进行解析刻画并经验验证。

sentences.en: Across six in-distribution and three out-of-distribution reasoning benchmarks, GRPO with DBB consistently outperforms naive GRPO and strong recent baselines, including the replay-based RePO and the variance-collapse-aware GRESO and DAPO.
sentences.zh: 在六个分布内与三个分布外推理基准上，带 DBB 的 GRPO 一致地超越朴素 GRPO 与强近期基线，包括基于重放的 RePO 与方差坍缩感知的 GRESO 与 DAPO。

sentences.en: Relative to GRPO, it achieves average Acc@8 improvements of 3.43/2.32 points in-distribution and 10.05/8.34 points out-of-distribution on the 1.7B and 8B models, respectively, without additional computational cost or memory usage.
sentences.zh: 相对于 GRPO，它在 1.7B 与 8B 模型上分别实现平均 Acc@8 改进，分布内为 3.43/2.32 分，分布外为 10.05/8.34 分，而无需额外计算成本或内存使用。

title_en: Discovering Differences in Strategic Behavior between Humans and LLMs
title_zh: 发现人类与大语言模型策略行为的差异

sentences.en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in social and strategic scenarios, it becomes critical to understand where and why their behavior diverges from that of humans.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）被日益部署于社会与战略场景，理解其行为在何处以及为何偏离人类变得至关重要。

sentences.en: While behavioral game theory (BGT) provides a framework for analyzing behavior, existing models do not fully capture the idiosyncratic behavior of humans or black-box, non-human agents like LLMs.
sentences.zh: 虽然行为博弈论（BGT）提供了分析行为的框架，但现有模型并未充分捕获人类或诸如 LLM 的黑盒非人类智能体的特有个体行为。

sentences.en: We employ AlphaEvolve, a cutting-edge program discovery tool, to directly discover *interpretable* models of human and LLM behavior from data, thereby enabling open-ended discovery of structural factors driving human and LLM behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们采用 AlphaEvolve，一个尖端的程序发现工具，直接从数据发现人类与 LLM 行为的*可解释*模型，从而能够开放式地发现驱动人类与 LLM 行为的结构因素。

sentences.en: Our analysis on iterated rock-paper-scissors reveals that frontier LLMs can be capable of deeper strategic behavior than humans.
sentences.zh: 我们对迭代石头剪刀布的分析揭示，前沿 LLM 能够表现出比人类更深的战略行为。

sentences.en: These results provide a foundation for understanding structural differences driving differences in human and LLM behavior in strategic interactions.
sentences.zh: 这些结果为理解战略交互中驱动人类与 LLM 行为差异的结构差异提供了基础。

authors.name: Pablo Samuel Castro
authors.institution: Google DeepMind / U. de Montreal / Mila

title_en: Discovering Implicit Large Language Model Alignment Objectives
title_zh: 发现大语言模型的隐式对齐目标

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM) alignment relies on complex reward signals that often obscure the specific behaviors being incentivized, creating critical risks of misalignment and reward hacking.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）对齐依赖常常遮蔽被激励的特定行为的复杂奖励信号，制造错位与奖励黑客的关键风险。

sentences.en: Existing interpretation methods typically rely on pre-defined rubrics, risking the omission of "unknown unknowns", or fail to identify objectives that comprehensively cover and are causal to the model behavior on some dataset.
sentences.zh: 现有的解释方法通常依赖预定义评分准则，有遗漏“未知的未知”的风险，或无法识别在某个数据集上全面覆盖且对模型行为具有因果性的目标。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we introduce Obj-Disco, a framework that automatically decomposes an alignment reward signal into a sparse, weighted combination of human-interpretable natural language objectives.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们引入 Obj-Disco，一个自动将对齐奖励信号分解为人类可解释自然语言目标的稀疏加权组合的框架。

sentences.en: Our approach utilizes an iterative greedy algorithm to analyze behavioral changes across training checkpoints, identifying and validating candidate objectives that best explain the residual reward signal.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法利用一种迭代贪心算法分析跨训练检查点的行为变化，识别并验证最能解释残差奖励信号的候选目标。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations across diverse tasks, model sizes, and alignment algorithms demonstrate the framework's robustness.
sentences.zh: 跨多样任务、模型规模与对齐算法的大量评估证明了该框架的稳健性。

sentences.en: Experiments with popular open-source reward models show that the framework consistently captures > 90\% of reward behavior, a finding further corroborated by human evaluation.
sentences.zh: 使用流行开源奖励模型的实验表明，该框架一致捕获超过 90\% 的奖励行为，这一发现在人工评估中得到进一步证实。

sentences.en: Additionally, a case study on alignment with an open-source reward model reveals that Obj-Disco can successfully identify latent misaligned incentives that emerge alongside intended behaviors.
sentences.zh: 此外，一个关于开源码奖励模型对齐的案例研究表明，Obj-Disco 能够成功识别出与预期行为一同浮现的潜在错位激励。

sentences.en: Our work provides a crucial tool for uncovering the implicit objectives in LLM alignment, paving the way for more transparent and safer AI development.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作为揭示 LLM 对齐中的隐式目标提供了关键工具，为更透明、更安全的 AI 开发铺平道路。

title_en: Discovering Interpretable Algorithms by Decompiling Transformers to RASP
title_zh: 通过将 Transformer 反编译为 RASP 发现可解释算法

sentences.en: Recent work has shown that the computations of Transformers can be simulated in the RASP family  of programming languages.
sentences.zh: 近期工作表明，Transformer 的计算可以在 RASP 编程语言家族中被模拟。

sentences.en: These findings have enabled improved understanding of the expressive capacity  and generalization abilities of Transformers.
sentences.zh: 这些发现使人们对 Transformer 的表达能力与泛化能力有了更好的理解。

sentences.en: In particular, Transformers have been suggested to length-generalize exactly on problems that have simple RASP programs.
sentences.zh: 特别是，有人提出 Transformer 恰好在具有简单 RASP 程序的问题上实现长度泛化。

sentences.en: However, it remains open whether trained models actually implement simple interpretable programs.
sentences.zh: 然而，训练后的模型是否真的实现简单可解释的程序仍是开放的。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present a general method to extract such programs from trained Transformers.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一个从训练后的 Transformer 提取此类程序的通用方法。

sentences.en: The idea is to faithfully re-parameterize a Transformer as a RASP program and then apply causal interventions to discover a small sufficient sub-program.
sentences.zh: 其思想是忠实地将 Transformer 重新参数化为 RASP 程序，然后应用因果干预发现一个小的充分子程序。

sentences.en: In experiments on small Transformers trained on algorithmic and formal language tasks, we show that our method often recovers simple and interpretable RASP programs from length-generalizing transformers.
sentences.zh: 在针对算法与形式语言任务训练的小型 Transformer 进行的实验中，我们表明我们的方法常常能从长度泛化的 Transformer 恢复简单且可解释的 RASP 程序。

sentences.en: Our results provide the most direct evidence so far that Transformers internally implement simple RASP programs.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果为 Transformer 内部实现简单 RASP 程序提供了迄今最直接的证据。

title_en: Discovering Ordinary Differential Equations with LLM-Based Qualitative and Quantitative Evaluation
title_zh: 利用基于大语言模型的定性与定量评估发现常微分方程

sentences.en: Discovering governing differential equations from observational data is a fundamental challenge in scientific machine learning.
sentences.zh: 从观测数据发现支配性的微分方程是科学机器学习中的一个基本挑战。

sentences.en: Existing symbolic regression approaches rely primarily on quantitative metrics; however, real-world differential equation modeling also requires incorporating domain knowledge to ensure physical plausibility.
sentences.zh: 现有的符号回归方法主要依赖定量指标；然而，现实世界的微分方程建模还需要纳入领域知识以确保物理合理性。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose DoLQ, a method for discovering ordinary differential equations with LLM-based qualitative and quantitative evaluation.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一差距，我们提出 DoLQ，一种用基于 LLM 的定性与定量评估发现常微分方程的方法。

sentences.en: DoLQ employs a multi-agent architecture: a Sampler Agent proposes dynamic system candidates, a Parameter Optimizer refines equations for accuracy, and a Scientist Agent leverages an LLM to conduct both qualitative and quantitative evaluations and synthesize their results to iteratively guide the search.
sentences.zh: DoLQ 采用多智能体架构：采样智能体提出动态系统候选，参数优化器精炼方程以获得准确率，科学家智能体利用 LLM 进行定性定量评估并综合其结果以迭代引导搜索。

sentences.en: Experiments on multi-dimensional ordinary differential equation benchmarks demonstrate that DoLQ achieves superior performance compared to existing methods, not only attaining higher success rates but also more accurately recovering the correct symbolic terms of ground truth equations.
sentences.zh: 在多维常微分方程基准上的实验表明，DoLQ 相对于现有方法取得卓越性能，不仅达成更高成功率，还更准确地恢复真值方程的正确答案符项。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/Bon99yun/DoLQ.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Bon99yun/DoLQ 获取。

title_en: Discovering Scaling Exponents with Physics-Informed Müntz-Szász Networks
title_zh: 利用物理信息 Müntz–Szász 网络发现缩放指数

sentences.en: Physical systems near singularities, interfaces, and critical points exhibit power-law scaling, yet standard neural networks leave the governing exponents implicit.
sentences.zh: 奇点、界面与临界点附近的物理系统表现出幂律缩放，然而标准神经网络使支配性指数保持隐式。

sentences.en: We introduce physics-informed Müntz-Szász Networks (MSN-PINN), a power-law basis network that treats scaling exponents as trainable parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们引入物理信息 Müntz-Szász 网络（MSN-PINN），一种将缩放指数作为可训练参数处理的幂律基网络。

sentences.en: The model outputs both the solution and its scaling structure.
sentences.zh: 该模型同时输出解及其缩放结构。

sentences.en: We prove identifiability, or unique recovery, and show that, under these conditions, the squared error between learned and true exponents scales as $O(|\mu - \alpha|^2)$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明可辨识性（或唯一恢复），并表明在这些条件下，学习指数与真实指数之间的平方误差按 $O(|\mu - \alpha|^2)$ 缩放。

sentences.en: Across experiments, MSN-PINN achieves single-exponent recovery with 1–5\% error under noise and sparse sampling.
sentences.zh: 跨实验，MSN-PINN 在噪声与稀疏采样下以 1-5\% 的误差实现单指数恢复。

sentences.en: It recovers corner singularity exponents for the two-dimensional Laplace equation with 0.009\% error, matches the classical result of Kondrat'ev (1967), and recovers forcing-induced exponents in singular Poisson problems with 0.03\% and 0.05\% errors.
sentences.zh: 它恢复二维 Laplace 方程的角奇点指数，误差为 0.009\%，匹配 Kondratev (1967) 的经典结果，并以 0.03\% 与 0.05\% 的误差恢复奇异 Poisson 问题中受力诱导的指数。

sentences.en: On a 40-configuration wedge benchmark, it reaches a 100\% success rate with 0.022\% mean error.
sentences.zh: 在一个 40 配置楔形基准上，它以 0.022\% 的平均误差达到 100\% 的成功率。

sentences.en: Constraint-aware training encodes physical requirements such as boundary condition compatibility and improves accuracy by three orders of magnitude over naive training.
sentences.zh: 约束感知训练编码边界条件兼容性等物理需求，并比朴素训练将准确率提高三个数量级。

authors.name: Gnankan Landry Regis N'guessan
authors.institution: Nelson Mandela African University of Science and Technology

title_en: Discovering Symmetry Groups with Flow Matching
title_zh: 利用流匹配发现对称群

sentences.en: Symmetry is fundamental to understanding physical systems and can improve performance and sample efficiency in machine learning.
sentences.zh: 对称性对理解物理系统至关重要，并能改善机器学习中的性能与样本效率。

sentences.en: Both pursuits require knowledge of the underlying symmetries in data, yet discovering these symmetries automatically is challenging.
sentences.zh: 这两项追求都需要数据中底层对称性的知识，然而自动发现这些对称性是具有挑战性的。

sentences.en: We propose LieFlow, a novel framework that reframes symmetry discovery as a distribution learning problem on Lie groups.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 LieFlow，一个将对称性发现重新表述为 Lie 群上分布学习问题的新颖框架。

sentences.en: Instead of searching for the symmetry generators, our approach operates directly in group space, modeling a symmetry distribution over a large hypothesis group $G$.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法不是搜索对称生成元，而是直接在群空间中运作，在大的假设群 G 上建模对称分布。

sentences.en: The support of the learned distribution reveals the underlying symmetry group $H \subseteq G$.
sentences.zh: 学习分布的支撑揭示了底层对称群 H，它是 G 的子集。

sentences.en: Unlike previous works, LieFlow can discover both continuous and discrete symmetries within a unified framework, without assuming a fixed Lie algebra basis or a specific distribution over the group elements.
sentences.zh: 与先前工作不同，LieFlow 可以在统一框架中发现连续与离散对称性，而无需假设固定的 Lie 代数基或群元素上的特定分布。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic 2D and 3D point clouds, ModelNet10, and a real-world MI-Motion dataset show that LieFlow accurately discovers continuous and discrete subgroups, significantly outperforming a state-of-the-art baseline, LieGAN, in identifying discrete symmetries.
sentences.zh: 在合成 2D 与 3D 点云、ModelNet10 与真实世界 MI-Motion 数据集上的实验表明，LieFlow 准确发现连续与离散子群，在识别离散对称性方面显著超越最先进的基线 LieGAN。

title_en: DiscoverLLM: From Executing Intents to Discovering Them
title_zh: DiscoverLLM：从执行意图到发现意图

sentences.en: To handle ambiguous and open-ended requests, Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly trained to interact with users to surface intents they have not yet expressed (e.g., ask clarification questions).
sentences.zh: 为处理模糊与开放式请求，大语言模型（LLM）正日益被训练与用户交互，以浮现他们尚未表达的意图（例如提出澄清性问题）。

sentences.en: However, users are often ambiguous because they have not yet formed their intents: they must observe and explore outcomes to discover what they want.
sentences.zh: 然而，用户常常因为尚未形成自己的意图而模糊：他们必须观察并探索结果以发现自己想要什么。

sentences.en: Simply asking "what kind of tone do you want?" fails when users themselves do not know.
sentences.zh: 当用户自己不知道时，简单地询问“你想要什么口吻？”是失败的。

sentences.en: We introduce DiscoverLLM, a novel and generalizable framework that trains LLMs to help users form and discover their intents.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 DiscoverLLM，一个新颖且可泛化的框架，它训练 LLM 帮助用户形成并发现自己的意图。

sentences.en: Central to our approach is a novel user simulator that models cognitive state with a hierarchy of intents that progressively concretize as the model surfaces relevant options---where the degree of concretization serves as a reward signal that models can be trained to optimize.
sentences.zh: 我们方法的核心是一个新颖的用户模拟器，它用意图层级对认知状态建模，随着模型浮现相关选项，这些意图逐步具体化——其中具体化程度充当模型可被训练优化的奖励信号。

sentences.en: Resulting models learn to collaborate with users by adaptively diverging (i.e., explore options) when intents are unclear, and converging (i.e., refine and implement) when intents concretize.
sentences.zh: 所得模型学会与用户协作，在意图不明确时自适应地发散（即探索选项），在意图具体化时收敛（即精炼并实现）。

sentences.en: Across proposed interactive benchmarks in creative writing, technical writing, and SVG drawing, DiscoverLLM achieves over 10% higher task performance while reducing conversation length by up to 40%.
sentences.zh: 在创意写作、技术写作与 SVG 绘制的所提交互式基准上，DiscoverLLM 实现超过 10% 更高的任务性能，同时将会话长度减少至多 40%。

sentences.en: In a user study with 75 human participants, DiscoverLLM improved conversation satisfaction and efficiency compared to baselines.
sentences.zh: 在 75 位人类参与者的用户研究中，DiscoverLLM 相较基线改善了会话满意度与效率。
