topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Discrete Adjoint Schrödinger Bridge Sampler
title_zh: 离散伴随薛定谔桥采样器

sentences.en: Learning discrete neural samplers is challenging due to the lack of gradients and combinatorial complexity.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏梯度与组合复杂度，学习离散神经采样器充满挑战。

sentences.en: While stochastic optimal control (SOC) and Schrödinger bridge (SB) provide principled solutions, efficient SOC solvers like adjoint matching (AM), which excel in continuous domains, remain unexplored for discrete spaces.
sentences.zh: 虽然随机最优控制（SOC）与 Schrödinger 桥（SB）提供了有原则的解决方案，但在连续域表现出色的高效 SOC 求解器（如伴随匹配（AM））在离散空间中仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: We bridge this gap by revealing that the core mechanism of AM is *state-space agnostic*, and introduce **discrete ASBS**, a unified framework that extends AM and adjoint Schrödinger bridge sampler (ASBS) to discrete spaces.
sentences.zh: 我们通过揭示 AM 的核心机制是*状态空间无关的*来弥合这一差距，并引入 **discrete ASBS**，一个将 AM 与伴随 Schrödinger 桥采样器（ASBS）扩展到离散空间的统一框架。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we analyze the optimality conditions of the discrete SB problem and its connection to SOC, identifying a necessary cyclic group structure on the state space to enable this extension.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们分析离散 SB 问题的最优性条件及其与 SOC 的联系，识别出状态空间上实现这种扩展所需的必要循环群结构。

sentences.en: Empirically, discrete ASBS achieves competitive sample quality with significant advantages in training efficiency and scalability.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，离散 ASBS 在训练效率与可扩展性上具有显著优势的同时实现有竞争力的样本质量。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/AlexandreGUO2001/DASBS.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/AlexandreGUO2001/DASBS 获取。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Discrete Diffusion Samplers and Bridges: Off-Policy Algorithms and Applications in Latent Spaces
title_zh: 离散扩散采样器与桥：离策略算法及其在潜在空间中的应用

sentences.en: Sampling from a distribution $p(x) \propto e^{-\mathcal{E}(x)}$ known up to a normalising constant is an important and challenging problem in statistics.
sentences.zh: 从已知至归一化常数的分布 p(x) 正比于 e^(-E(x)) 采样，是统计学中一个重要且富有挑战性的问题。

sentences.en: Recent years have seen the rise of a new family of amortised sampling algorithms, commonly referred to as diffusion samplers, that enable fast and efficient sampling from an unnormalised density.
sentences.zh: 近年来，一类新的摊销采样算法（通常称为扩散采样器）兴起，它们支持从未归一化密度进行快速高效采样。

sentences.en: Such algorithms have been widely studied for continuous-space sampling tasks; however, their application to problems in discrete space remains largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 此类算法已被广泛研究用于连续空间采样任务；然而，它们在离散空间问题上的应用在很大程度上仍未被探索。

sentences.en: Although some progress has been made in this area, discrete diffusion samplers do not take full advantage of ideas commonly used for continuous-space sampling.
sentences.zh: 虽然此领域已取得一些进展，但离散扩散采样器并未充分利用常用于连续空间采样的思想。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose to bridge this gap by introducing off-policy training techniques for discrete diffusion samplers.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提议通过为离散扩散采样器引入离策略训练技术来弥合这一差距。

sentences.en: We show that these techniques improve the performance of discrete samplers on both established and new synthetic benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这些技术在既有与新合成基准上都改善了离散采样器的性能。

sentences.en: Next, we generalise discrete diffusion samplers to the task of bridging between two arbitrary distributions, introducing data-to-energy Schrödinger bridge training for the discrete domain for the first time.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们将离散扩散采样器推广到两个任意分布之间桥接的任务，首次引入面向离散领域的数据到能量 Schrödinger 桥训练。

sentences.en: Lastly, we showcase the application of the proposed diffusion samplers to data-free posterior sampling in the discrete latent spaces of image generative models.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们展示所提出的扩散采样器在图像生成模型离散潜在空间中进行无数据后验采样的应用。

authors.name: Kirill Tamogashev
authors.institution: University of Edinburgh, University of Edinburgh

title_en: Discrete Diffusion VLA: Bringing Discrete Diffusion to Action Decoding in Vision-Language-Action Policies
title_zh: Discrete Diffusion VLA：将离散扩散引入视觉–语言–动作策略的动作解码

sentences.en: Vision–Language–Action (VLA) models adapt large vision–language backbones to map images and instructions into robot actions.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型适配大型视觉-语言主干，将图像与指令映射为机器人动作。

sentences.en: However, prevailing VLAs either generate actions autoregressively in a fixed left-to-right order with poor performance or attach separate diffusion heads outside the backbone that fragments information pathways and hinders unified, scalable architectures.
sentences.zh: 然而，主流 VLA 要么以固定从左到右顺序自回归生成动作而性能不佳，要么在主干之外附加分离的扩散头，这碎片化信息通路并阻碍统一、可扩展的架构。

sentences.en: Instead, we present Discrete Diffusion VLA that discretizes action chunks and models them with discrete diffusion pattern retaining progressive refinement inside the unified transformer backbone.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们提出离散扩散 VLA，它离散化动作块并用离散扩散模式对其建模，在统一 Transformer 主干内保留渐进精炼。

sentences.en: Our method achieves an adaptive decoding order that resolves high-confidence action elements before harder ones and employs secondary re-masking to revisit uncertain predictions, enabling robust error correction.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法实现自适应解码顺序，先解析高置信动作元素再处理较难元素，并采用二次重新掩码重新审视不确定预测，实现稳健的错误修正。

sentences.en: This design preserves pretrained vision-language priors, supports parallel decoding, and improves the efficiency.
sentences.zh: 这一设计保留预训练的视觉-语言先验，支持并行解码，并提高效率。

sentences.en: Discrete Diffusion VLA achieves 96.4% avg. success on LIBERO, 71.2% visual matching on SimplerEnv-Fractal, and 54.2% overall on SimplerEnv-Bridge.
sentences.zh: 离散扩散 VLA 在 LIBERO 上实现 96.4% 的平均成功率，在 SimplerEnv-Fractal 上实现 71.2% 的视觉匹配，在 SimplerEnv-Bridge 上实现 54.2% 的总体表现。

sentences.en: On out-of-distribution tests of LIBERO-Goal, our method exhibits only 0.8% language degradation versus 8.0% of parallel decoding, and 20.4% vision degradation versus 29.0% for continuous diffusion, demonstrating well retention of pretrained vision-language capabilities.
sentences.zh: 在 LIBERO-Goal 的分布外测试中，我们的方法仅显示 0.8% 的语言退化（而并行解码为 8.0%），以及 20.4% 的视觉退化（而连续扩散为 29.0%），表明对预训练视觉-语言能力的良好保持。

sentences.en: We also conduct two real-robot evaluations on AgileX Cobot Magic platform to show the method's effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 我们还在 AgileX Cobot Magic 平台上进行两次真实机器人评估，以展示方法的有效性。

authors.name: Xiaokang Yang
authors.institution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University of China

title_en: Discrete Diffusion with Physical Mass Constraints for \emph{De Novo} Peptide Sequencing
title_zh: 具有物理质量约束的离散扩散，用于从头肽测序

sentences.en: $\textit{De novo}$ peptide sequencing is a pivotal technique that directly reconstructs amino acid sequences from tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) data; it enables the identification of novel proteins and variants absent from reference databases.
sentences.zh: 全新肽测序是一种关键技术，它直接从串联质谱（MS/MS）数据重建氨基酸序列；它使得能够识别参考数据库中不存在的具有新蛋白质与变体。

sentences.en: Previous methods are typically based on autoregressive (AR) decoding or one-shot generation.
sentences.zh: 先前方法通常基于自回归（AR）解码或一次性生成。

sentences.en: The AR-based methods conflict with the bidirectional and globally constrained nature of MS/MS evidence and inevitably accumulate errors, while one-shot generation does not explicitly enforce physical constraints, failing to produce chemically valid and reliable peptides in a single pass.
sentences.zh: AR 方法使 MS/MS 证据的双向且全局约束性质相冲突，并不可避免地累积误差，而一次性生成不显式强制物理约束，无法在单次通过中产生化学上有效且可靠的肽。

sentences.en: Accurate sequencing necessitates reasoning over the entire peptide simultaneously, enabling iterative self-correction under global constraints.
sentences.zh: 准确的测序需要同时在整个肽上推理，从而能够在全局约束下进行迭代自我修正。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce $\textbf{PhysNovo}$, a novel paradigm that harnesses discrete diffusion to enable simultaneous global reasoning and iterative refinement.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入 \textbf{PhysNovo}，一种利用离散扩散实现同步全局推理与迭代精炼的新颖范式。

sentences.en: Specifically, PhysNovo reformulates sequencing as a $\textbf{phys}$ically mass-constrained reasoning process by embedding a knapsack-based feasibility kernel to enforce exact precursor mass consistency.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，PhysNovo 通过嵌入一个基于背包的可行性核来强制精确的前体质量一致性，将测序重新表述为一个**物**理质量约束的推理过程。

sentences.en: By conditioning the diffusion process on global spectral context, PhysNovo supports abductive reasoning where bidirectional evidence is exploited to iteratively resolve local inconsistencies and ensure physically valid predictions.
sentences.zh: 通过以全局谱上下文为条件进行扩散，PhysNovo 支持溯因推理，其中利用双向证据迭代解决局部不一致并确保物理有效的预测。

sentences.en: PhysNovo achieves state-of-the-art performance, exceeding baselines by over 2% in precision, with larger gains on out-of-distribution data.
sentences.zh: PhysNovo 取得最先进的性能，在精确率上超越基线超过 2%，在分布外数据上获得更大增益。

sentences.en: The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/WanyuGroup/ICML2026_PhysNovo.
sentences.zh: 源代码公开于 https://github.com/WanyuGroup/ICML2026_PhysNovo。

authors.name: Wanyu LIN
authors.institution: Department of Computing, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Discrete Survival Knowledge Distillation for Competing Risks Analysis
title_zh: 用于竞争风险分析的离散生存知识蒸馏

sentences.en: Accurate prediction in survival analysis with competing risks is challenged by rare event rates and limited effective sample sizes.
sentences.zh: 带竞争风险的生存分析中的准确预测受到罕见事件率与有限有效样本量的挑战。

sentences.en: Knowledge distillation offers a promising way to transfer information from an external teacher to improve a local student, but existing methods are overwhelmingly developed for uncensored outcomes and do not directly extend to survival analysis, where censored observations provide only partial information.
sentences.zh: 知识蒸馏为将信息从外部教师转移到改进本地学生提供了一种有前景的方式，但现有方法绝大多数是为未删失结局开发的，无法直接扩展到生存分析，其中删失观测仅提供部分信息。

sentences.en: Moreover, prior work often assumes that teacher and student share identical outcome definitions, whereas in competing risks settings, they may differ in outcome granularity and event definitions, further complicating knowledge transfer.
sentences.zh: 此外，先前工作常常假设教师与学生共享相同的结局定义，而在竞争风险情境中，它们可能在结局粒度与事件定义上有所不同，进一步复杂化知识转移。

sentences.en: To address these gaps, we propose DiSKD (Discrete Survival Knowledge Distillation), a deep learning framework for discrete-time competing risks that integrates teacher predictions via a cause-specific, time-dependent Kullback-Leibler divergence.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些差距，我们提出 DiSKD（离散生存知识蒸馏），一个用于离散时间竞争风险的深度学习框架，它通过原因特定、时间依赖的 Kullback-Leibler 散度整合教师预测。

sentences.en: DiSKD enables flexible and privacy-conscious transfer without requiring raw data sharing, remains robust to model misspecification or outcome-definition heterogeneity, and adaptively weights teacher guidance by emphasizing compatible teachers while down-weighting less relevant ones.
sentences.zh: DiSKD 无需原始数据共享即可实现灵活且隐私考量的转移，对模型误设或结局定义异质性保持稳健，并通过强调相容教师而降低不相关教师的权重来自适应地加权教师指导。

sentences.en: Simulation studies and real-world applications demonstrate improved discrimination and calibration.
sentences.zh: 模拟研究与现实应用展示了改进的判别力与校准。

title_en: Discrete Tilt Matching
title_zh: 离散倾斜匹配

sentences.en: Masked diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are a promising alternative to autoregressive generation.
sentences.zh: 掩码扩散大语言模型（dLLM）是自回归生成的有前景替代方案。

sentences.en: While reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have been adapted to be compatible with dLLMs for fine-tuning them, their reliance on the computation of the marginal likelihood to evaluate policy objectives is intractable.
sentences.zh: 虽然强化学习（RL）算法已被适配为与 dLLM 相容以微调它们，但它们对计算边际似然评估策略目标的依赖是不可处理的。

sentences.en: To overcome this, we exploit a dynamical relation between the unmasking posterior of the base model and that which targets the reward-tilted distribution to derive Discrete Tilt Matching (DTM), an algorithm that avoids intractable likelihood evaluation entirely.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一点，我们利用基础模型的去掩码后验与针对奖励倾斜分布的使测后验之间的动力学关系，推导出离散倾斜匹配（DTM），一种完全避免不可处理似然评估的算法。

sentences.en: DTM can be phrased as a cross-entropy loss that only requires forward evaluation of rewards and whose variance can be adaptively controlled, improving training stability.
sentences.zh: DTM 可以被表述为一个仅需前向评估奖励的交叉熵损失，其方差可以被自适应控制，改善训练稳定性。

sentences.en: We motivate DTM on maze planning tasks, and show that fine-tuning LLaDA-8B-Instruct with DTM achieves higher accuracy at lower compute costs than prior RL-based fine-tuning methods across the Sudoku, Countdown, and MATH500 benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们在迷宫规划任务上论证 DTM，并表明用 DTM 微调 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 在 Sudoku、Countdown 与 MATH500 基准上以更低计算成本取得比先前基于 RL 的微调方法更高的准确率。

title_en: Discretely-Refined Multi-view Clustering via Aligned Anchor Learning
title_zh: 通过对齐锚点学习进行离散细化多视图聚类

sentences.en: Anchor-based multi-view clustering has garnered wide attention for its ability to reduce the computational complexity of large-scale spectral clustering.
sentences.zh: 基于锚点的多视角聚类因其降低大规模谱聚类计算复杂性的能力而获得广泛关注。

sentences.en: However, existing methods mostly adopt a unidirectional optimization paradigm confined to sample-anchor bipartite graphs, treating the construction of the consensus graph and discrete clustering assignments as separate sub-problems to be solved independently.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法大多采用局限于样本-锚点二分图的单向优化范式，将共识图构建与离散聚类分配视为各自独立求解的分离子问题。

sentences.en: This  weakens the information exchange between continuous representation and discrete structure, confining the optimization process to iterative updates within local modules.
sentences.zh: 这削弱了连续表示与离散结构之间的信息交换，将优化过程限制在局部模块内的迭代更新。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose a Discretely-Refined Multi-view Clustering(DRMC) via Aligned Anchor Learning.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们提出通过对齐锚点学习的离散精炼多视角聚类（DRMC）。

sentences.en: Unlike approaches that directly perform fusion in the anchor space, our method starts from the anchor graph, elevates sample-anchor associations to sample-level similarity graph representations, and thereby enhances both within-cluster similarity and between-cluster separation.
sentences.zh: 与直接在锚点空间中执行融合的方法不同，我们的方法从锚点图出发，将样本-锚点关联提升为样本级相似图表示，从而增强簇内相似性与簇间分离。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we design a discrete feedback module that jointly conducts spectral embedding learning and discrete label assignment by orthogonally aligning the continuous embedding matrix with the discrete indicator matrix.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们设计一个离散反馈模块，通过将连续嵌入矩阵与离散指示矩阵正交对齐，联合执行谱嵌入学习与离散标签分配。

sentences.en: The resulting discrete partition is then fed back into the consensus graph construction, continuously refining the graph structure.
sentences.zh: 所得的离散划分随后被反馈到共识图构建中，持续精炼图结构。

sentences.en: Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed method exhibits significant advantages over existing state-of-the-art approaches.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法相对现有最先进方法展现出显著优势。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Discretized Density-Guided Source-Free Adaptation for Continuous Targets
title_zh: 针对连续目标的离散化密度引导无源域适配

sentences.en: Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA) enables model adaptation under distribution shifts without access to source data, providing a practical solution for privacy-sensitive applications and having shown substantial progress in classification.
sentences.zh: 无源领域适配（SFDA）能够在无法访问源数据的情况下进行分布偏移下的模型适配，为隐私敏感应用提供实用解决方案，并在分类方面显示出实质进展。

sentences.en: In contrast, regression involves ordered and continuous target variables, posing unique challenges for representation adaptation and pseudo-label refinement in the SFDA setting.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，回归涉及有序且连续的目标变量，在 SFDA 情境中对表示适配与伪标签精炼提出独特挑战。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose a novel algorithm for continuous target prediction in SFDA that leverages instance-dependent, discretized density–informed supervisory signals to refine pseudo-labels within an uncertainty-aware paradigm.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一差距，我们提出一种用于 SFDA 中连续目标预测的新颖算法，它利用实例依赖、离散化密度知情的监督信号，在不确定性感知范式中精炼伪标签。

sentences.en: By incorporating auxiliary discretized distribution learning, our method also promotes more compact and structured feature representations, mitigating the inherent difficulties of adapting regression models under distribution shift.
sentences.zh: 通过纳入辅助的离散化分布学习，我们的方法还促进更紧凑、更结构化的特征表示，缓解分布偏移下适配回归模型的固有困难。

sentences.en: We theoretically demonstrate that the resulting density structure is robust to potential perturbations, supporting reliable SFDA for regression.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上证明所得的密度结构对潜在扰动保持稳健，支持可靠的回归 SFDA。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
sentences.zh: 跨多个基准的大量实验验证了所提出方法的有效性。

title_en: Discriminative Attribute Graph Clustering Through Topology-Guided Contrastive Learning
title_zh: 通过拓扑引导对比学习进行判别式属性图聚类

sentences.en: Deep attribute graph clustering aims to learn discriminative node representations by leveraging both node attributes and graph topology to partition nodes into distinct clusters.
sentences.zh: 深度属性图聚类旨在通过利用节点属性与图拓扑学习判别性节点表示，将节点划分为不同聚类。

sentences.en: Although substantial progress has been made in attribute-graph clustering in recent years, two key challenges remain: noisy edges in the original adjacency matrix degrade the quality of information propagation, and redundant feature information across different feature views hampers the learning of discriminative representations.
sentences.zh: 尽管近年来属性图聚类取得了实质进展，但仍有两大挑战：原始邻接矩阵中的噪声边降低了信息传播质量，以及跨不同特征视图的冗余特征信息妨害了判别性表示的学习。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose a self-supervised attribute graph clustering method based on topological reconstruction and correlation decorrelation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出一种基于拓扑重构与相关去相关的自监督属性图聚类方法。

sentences.en: First, we reconstruct the graph topology by computing intersections between k-nearest neighbors and the original adjacency relationships, while simultaneously leveraging global semantic information from K-means clustering to filter out noisy nodes.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们通过计算 k 近邻与原始邻接关系之间的交集重构图拓扑，同时利用 K-means 聚类的全局语义信息滤除噪声节点。

sentences.en: This reconstructed topology effectively mitigates information redundancy during feature aggregation in Graph Neural Networks.
sentences.zh: 这种重构的拓扑有效缓解了图神经网络特征聚合过程中的信息冗余。

sentences.en: Second, unlike existing augmentation-based contrastive methods, we treat the feature representations from an auto-encoder (AE) and a graph auto-encoder (GAE) as two complementary natural views.
sentences.zh: 其次，与现有的基于增广的对比方法不同，我们将自编码器（AE）与图自编码器（GAE）的特征表示视为两个互补的自然视图。

sentences.en: We then apply mutual information minimization and a decorrelation constraint to suppress redundant information between views, yielding more discriminative node representations.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们应用互信息最小化与去相关约束抑制视图之间的冗余信息，产生更具判别性的节点表示。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on four widely-used graph datasets—ACM, DBLP, CITE, and AMAP—demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms six state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 在四个广泛使用的图数据集（ACM、DBLP、CITE 与 AMAP）上的大量实验表明，我们的方法一致地超越六个最先进的基线。

title_en: Discriminative Mixture-of-Experts on Graphs with Reliable Expert Fusion
title_zh: 结合可靠专家融合的图上判别式混合专家模型

sentences.en: Graph Mixture-of-Experts (Graph-MoE) offers a way to scale GNNs via adaptive capacity allocation, with the goal of allowing different experts to capture diverse graph patterns.
sentences.zh: 图混合专家（Graph-MoE）通过自适应容量分配提供一种扩展 GNN 的方式，目标是让不同专家捕获多样的图模式。

sentences.en: Its effectiveness heavily depends on the coordination between routing decisions and expert specialization.
sentences.zh: 其有效性很大程度上取决于路由决策与专家特化之间的协调。

sentences.en: However, through extensive empirical study, we identify two critical phenomena.
sentences.zh: 然而，通过广泛的经验研究，我们识别出两个关键现象。

sentences.en: First, discrimination loss occurs on both the expert and routing sides, where GNN experts become highly homogenized and the router collapses to a small subset of experts, failing to reflect diverse graph semantics.
sentences.zh: 首先，在专家侧与路由侧都发生判别性损失，GNN 专家变得高度同质化，路由器坍缩到专家的小子集，未能反映多样图语义。

sentences.en: Second, routing uncertainty is prevalent, as existing routers produce uncertain expert assignments for most nodes, and such uncertainty exhibits a strong negative correlation with model performance.
sentences.zh: 其次，路由不确定性普遍存在，现有路由器对大多数节点产生不确定的专家分配，并且这种不确定性与模型性能表现出强负相关。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose C$^2$GMoE, a novel Graph-MoE framework featuring Contrastive routing and Confidence-aware fusion.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出 C$^2$GMoE，一个具有对比路由与置信感知融合的新颖 Graph-MoE 框架。

sentences.en: We introduce a group-wise contrastive routing strategy that provides explicit guidance for routing optimization by aligning node-level routing decisions with semantic clusters while satisfying load-balancing constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一种分组对比路由策略，它通过将节点级路由决策与语义聚类对齐，同时满足负载均衡约束，为路由优化提供显式指导。

sentences.en: Moreover, through a theoretical analysis of generalization error, we develop a confidence-aware fusion mechanism that adaptively reweights expert predictions according to their confidence.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过泛化误差的理论分析，我们开发一种置信感知融合机制，它根据专家预测的置信度自适应地重新加权。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed C$^2$GMoE.
sentences.zh: 跨多个基准的大量实验证明了我们提出的 C$^2$GMoE 的有效性。

title_en: Discriminative Visual Process Rewards for Scaling Thinking at Test-Time with Images
title_zh: 通过判别式视觉过程奖励扩展利用图像的测试时思考

sentences.en: The “thinking with images” paradigm has led multimodal large language models to generate intermediate visual steps—such as cropping, annotation, spatial localization, and sketches—to enhance high-resolution perception and complex reasoning.
sentences.zh: “带图像思考”范式已使多模态大语言模型生成中间视觉步骤——例如裁剪、标注、空间定位与草图——以增强高分辨率感知与复杂推理。

sentences.en: However, existing multimodal Process Reward Models (PRMs) evaluate only textual reasoning and cannot judge the correctness of these visual steps, creating a key gap when visual reasoning is essential for solving tasks.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的多模态过程奖励模型（PRM）仅评估文本推理，无法判断这些视觉步骤的正确性，在视觉推理对求解任务至关重要的情境中制造一个关键空白。

sentences.en: We propose Discriminative Visual Process Reward Model (DiscPRM), a multimodal PRM that jointly evaluates textual and visual intermediate steps by modeling visual reasoning trajectories, image operations, and text-image consistency.
sentences.zh: 我们提出判别性视觉过程奖励模型（DiscPRM），一个联合评估文本与视觉中间步骤的多模态 PRM，它通过建模视觉推理轨迹、图像操作与文本-图像一致性实现。

sentences.en: To support this, we build VTReward-100K, a dataset of step-by-step visual reasoning sequences with supervision.
sentences.zh: 为支持这一点，我们构建 VTReward-100K，一个带监督的逐步视觉推理序列数据集。

sentences.en: Experiments show that using DiscPRM for Best-of-N process supervision substantially improves multimodal reasoning performance on tasks requiring visual intermediate steps, achieving over 5% gains across benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，使用 DiscPRM 进行最佳 N 过程监督，在需要视觉中间步骤的任务上大幅提升多模态推理性能，跨基准实现超过 5% 的增益。

sentences.en: We further introduce VABench, the first benchmark for evaluating PRMs on visual reasoning error detection.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入 VABench，首个用于在视觉推理错误检测上评估 PRM 的基准。

sentences.en: We hope this work can provide foundational support for advancing the emerging direction of visual–textual process reward.
sentences.zh: 我们希望这项工作能为推进视觉-文本过程奖励这一新兴方向提供基础支持。

title_en: Disease-Centric Vision-Language Pretraining with Hybrid Visual Encoding for 3D Computed Tomography
title_zh: 面向三维计算机断层成像、结合混合视觉编码的疾病中心视觉语言预训练

sentences.en: Vision–language pre-training (VLP) holds great promise for general-purpose medical AI by leveraging radiology reports as rich textual supervision, yet existing methods struggle with 3D CT imaging due to inefficient visual backbones and coarse semantic alignment.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言预训练（VLP）通过利用放射学报告作为丰富的文本监督，对通用医疗 AI 大有可为，然而现有方法因低效视觉主干与粗略语义对齐而在 3D CT 成像上表现挣扎。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose a tailored VLP framework featuring three key components: (1) a CNN–ViT hybrid encoder that replaces ViT’s patch embedding with a 3D CNN backbone to efficiently capture local anatomical details while preserving global attention and compatibility with pre-trained cross-modal priors; (2) a disease-level contrastive learning mechanism using learnable query tokens to dynamically extract disease-specific semantics from full reports and align them with corresponding visual features, thereby disentangling distinct diseases within the same anatomical region; and (3) a diagnosis-aware prompt strategy that employs real clinical phrases and aggregated disease prototypes to bridge the pre-training–inference gap and enhance zero-shot diagnostic reliability.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出一个个性化的 VLP 框架，包含三个关键组件：（1）一个 CNN-ViT 混合编码器，它用 3D CNN 主干取代 ViT 的分块嵌入，以高效捕获局部解剖细节，同时保留全局注意力与预训练跨模态先验的兼容性；（2）一个疾病级对比学习机制，使用可学习查询词元从完整报告动态提取疾病特定语义，并与相应视觉特征对齐，从而在同一解剖区域内解缠不同疾病；以及（3）一个诊断感知提示策略，采用真实临床短语与聚合疾病原型弥合预训练-推断差距，增强零样本诊断可靠性。

sentences.en: Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on CT-RATE (84.4\% AUC, +5.1%) and Rad-ChestCT (75.4\% AUC, +5.4%), with even larger gains (+9.8% AUC) on a challenging 60-disease benchmark, and demonstrates strong transferability to radiology report generation, underscoring the generality and clinical utility of our approach.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型在 CT-RATE（84.4\% AUC，+5.1%）与 Rad-ChestCT（75.4\% AUC，+5.4%）上取得最先进性能，在具有挑战性的 60 疾病基准上获得更大增益（+9.8\% AUC），并展现出向放射学报告生成的强可迁移性，彰显了我们方法的通用性与临床实用性。

title_en: Disentangling Consensus and Value-Specific Representations for Controllable Pluralistic Value Alignment of LLMs
title_zh: 解耦共识与价值特定表征，实现大语言模型可控的多元价值对齐

sentences.en: With the widespread deployment of large language models (LLMs), aligning model outputs with pluralistic human values has become an important research problem.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的广泛部署，将模型输出与多元人类价值观对齐已成为一个重要的研究问题。

sentences.en: Recent approaches that train task-specific experts and merge them through parameter aggregation have shown promise for pluralistic alignment.
sentences.zh: 近期训练任务特定专家并通过参数聚合合并它们的方法，对多元对齐展现出前景。

sentences.en: However, these methods often overlook the intrinsic complexity of real-world value data, where multiple correlated value dimensions coexist, resulting in highly similar and entangled expert representations.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法常常忽视现实世界价值数据的内在复杂性，其中多个相关的价值维度共存，导致高度相似且纠缠的专家表示。

sentences.en: Consequently, modifying the contribution of one value expert may unintentionally influence other values, limiting fine-grained controllability.
sentences.zh: 因此，修改一个价值专家的贡献可能无意中影响其他价值，限制了细粒度可控性。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose DisAlign, a model-merging framework that explicitly decomposes value representations into consensus and value-specific components using an information-geometric perspective.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 DisAlign，一个模型合并框架，它利用信息几何视角将价值表示显式分解为共识与价值特定组件。

sentences.en: DisAlign first extracts a consensus anchor and subspace to capture shared structure across values, and then applies spectral decomposition to the residual representations to construct disentangled value subspaces.
sentences.zh: DisAlign 首先提取一个共识锚点与子空间以捕获跨价值的共享结构，然后对残差表示应用谱分解以构建解缠的价值子空间。

sentences.en: This design enables more precise and independent modulation of multiple values.
sentences.zh: 这一设计支持对多种价值进行更精确、更独立的调制。

sentences.en: Experiments on three datasets covering different value frameworks demonstrate that DisAlign consistently improves value disentanglement and achieves more accurate pluralistic value control compared to existing baselines.
sentences.zh: 在覆盖不同价值框架的三个数据集上的实验表明，相较现有基线，DisAlign 一致地改善价值解缠并实现更准确的多元价值控制。

sentences.en: Our code is available at \url{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DisAlign-7F35}
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DisAlign-7F35 获取。

title_en: Disentangling Geometry, Performance, and Training in Language Models
title_zh: 解耦语言模型中的几何、性能与训练

sentences.en: Geometric properties of Transformer weights, particularly the unembedding matrix, have been widely useful in language model interpretability research.
sentences.zh: Transformer 权重的几何性质，尤其是去嵌入矩阵，已在语言模型可解释性研究中被广泛使用。

sentences.en: Yet, their utility for estimating downstream performance remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们用于估计下游性能的效用仍不清楚。

sentences.en: In this work, we systematically investigate the relationship between model performance and the unembedding matrix geometry, particularly its effective rank.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们系统性地研究模型性能与去嵌入矩阵几何（特别是其有效秩）之间的关系。

sentences.en: Our experiments, involving a suite of 108 OLMo-style language models trained under controlled variation, reveal several key findings.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验涉及在受控变化下训练的 108 个 OLMo 风格语言模型的套件，揭示出几个关键发现。

sentences.en: While the best-performing models often exhibit a high effective rank, this trend is not universal across tasks and training setups.
sentences.zh: 虽然表现最佳的模型常常表现出高有效秩，但这一趋势并非跨任务与训练设置普遍成立。

sentences.en: Contrary to prior work, we find that low effective rank does not cause late-stage performance degradation in small models, but instead co-occurs with it; we find adversarial cases where low-rank models do not exhibit saturation.
sentences.zh: 与先前工作相反，我们发现低有效秩不会在小模型中引起后期性能退化，而是与其共现；我们找到低秩模型不表现出饱和的对抗性案例。

sentences.en: Moreover, we show that effective rank is strongly influenced by pre-training hyperparameters, such as batch size and weight decay, which in-turn affect the model's performance.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明有效秩受预训练超参数（如批量大小与权重衰减）的强烈影响，而这些又影响模型的性能。

sentences.en: Lastly, extending our analysis to other geometric metrics and final-layer representation, we find that these metrics are largely aligned, but none can reliably predict downstream performance.
sentences.zh: 最后，将我们的分析扩展到其他几何指标与最终层表示，我们发现这些指标大体一致，但没有任何一个能可靠预测下游性能。

sentences.en: Overall, our findings suggest that the model's geometry, as captured by existing metrics, primarily reflects training choices rather than performance.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的发现表明，被现有指标捕获的模型几何主要反映训练选择而非性能。

title_en: Disentangling Intent from Role: Adversarial Self-Play for Persona-Invariant Safety Alignment
title_zh: 解耦意图与角色：通过对抗自博弈实现角色不变安全对齐

sentences.en: The growing capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have driven their widespread deployment across diverse domains, even in potentially high-risk scenarios.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）不断增强的能力推动了它们在多样领域的广泛部署，甚至包括潜在高风险场景。

sentences.en: Despite advances in safety alignment techniques, current models remain vulnerable to emerging *persona-based jailbreak attacks*.
sentences.zh: 尽管安全对齐技术取得进展，当前模型仍然容易受到新兴的*基于人格的越狱攻击*。

sentences.en: Existing research on persona-based jailbreak has primarily focused on attack iterations, yet it lacks systemic and mechanistic constraints on the defense side.
sentences.zh: 现有关于基于人格越狱的研究主要聚焦于攻击迭代，然而它缺乏对防御侧的系统性与机制性约束。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose Persona-Invariant Alignment (PIA), an adversarial self-play framework that achieves co-evolution through Persona Lineage Evolution (PLE) on the attack side and Persona-Invariant Consistency Learning (PICL) on the defense side.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出人格不变对齐（PIA），一个对抗性自我对弈框架，它通过攻击侧的人格谱系演化（PLE）与防御侧的人格不变一致性学习（PICL）实现协同演化。

sentences.en: Theoretically, PICL is grounded in the *structural separation hypothesis*, using a unilateral KL-divergence constraint to enable the structural decoupling of safety decisions from persona context, thereby maintaining safe behavior under persona-based jailbreak attacks.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，PICL 植根于*结构分离假说*，使用单侧 KL 散度约束使安全决策从人格上下文结构解耦，从而在基于人格的越狱攻击下保持安全行为。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that PLE efficiently explores high-risk persona spaces by leveraging lineage-based credit propagation.
sentences.zh: 实验结果证明，PLE 通过利用谱系为基础的信用传播高效探索高风险人格空间。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the PICL defense method significantly reduces the Attack Success Rate (ASR) while preserving the model's general capability, thereby validating the superiority and robustness of this alignment paradigm.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，PICL 防御方法在保持模型通用能力的同时显著降低攻击成功率（ASR），从而验证了这一对齐范式的优越性与稳健性。

title_en: Disentangling Latent Risk Pathways via Bayesian Hypergraph Inference
title_zh: 通过贝叶斯超图推断解耦潜在风险路径

sentences.en: Electronic health records (EHR) pose large-scale multi-disease modeling problems in which many outcomes are rare and strongly influenced by shared risk factors.
sentences.zh: 电子健康记录（EHR）提出大规模多疾病建模问题，其中许多结局是罕见的，并受到共享风险因素的强烈影响。

sentences.en: While modern approaches achieve strong predictive performance, they often treat diseases independently or rely on black-box architectures, offering limited insight into how risk factors organize disease risk and little principled uncertainty quantification.
sentences.zh: 虽然现代方法实现了强预测性能，但它们常常独立处理疾病或依赖黑盒架构，对风险因素如何组织疾病风险提供有限洞见，并且几乎不提供有原则的不确定性量化。

sentences.en: We introduce a Bayesian hypergraph inference framework that reframes multi-disease modeling around **latent, risk-factor-modulated disease pathways**.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个贝叶斯超图推断框架，它围绕**潜在的风险因素调制的疾病通路**重新表述多疾病建模。

sentences.en: Risk factors act on hyperedges, latent disease subsets with shared risk patterns, allowing diseases to participate in multiple distinct pathways and enabling interpretable, higher-order structure beyond pairwise associations.
sentences.zh: 风险因素作用于超边（共享风险模式的潜在疾病子集），使疾病能够参与多个不同通路，并实现超越成对关联的可解释的高阶结构。

sentences.en: A repulsion prior encourages parsimonious and identifiable structure, while posterior inference provides calibrated uncertainty over both disease groupings and risk-factor influence.
sentences.zh: 一个排斥先验鼓励简约且可辨识的结构，而后验推断对疾病分组与风险因素影响两者提供校准的不确定性。

sentences.en: To enable scalable inference on large EHR datasets, we develop a structured variational inference algorithm that preserves logical dependencies among hyperedge existence, disease membership, and pathway-level effects.
sentences.zh: 为支持大型 EHR 数据集上的可扩展推断，我们开发一种结构化变分推断算法，它保持超边存在性、疾病成员资格与通路级效应之间的逻辑依赖。

sentences.en: Experiments on simulated data and UK Biobank demonstrate stable and interpretable disease pathway structure, well-calibrated uncertainty, improved estimation for rare diseases, and competitive predictive performance.
sentences.zh: 在模拟数据与 UK Biobank 上的实验展示了稳定且可解释的疾病通路结构、校准良好的不确定性、对罕见疾病改进的估计以及有竞争力的预测性能。

title_en: DisjunctiveNet: Neural Symbolic Learning via Differentiable Convexified Optimization Layers
title_zh: DisjunctiveNet：通过可微凸化优化层实现神经符号学习

sentences.en: Many learning tasks in science and engineering are characterized by sparse datasets, which limits the effectiveness of purely data-driven approaches.
sentences.zh: 科学与工程中的许多学习任务以稀疏数据集为特征，这限制了纯数据驱动方法的有效性。

sentences.en: At the same time, these problems are often accompanied by rich domain knowledge derived from physical laws, operational requirements, and expert heuristics.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这些问题常常伴随由物理定律、操作要求与专家启发式得出的丰富领域知识。

sentences.en: Such knowledge is frequently expressed as rules involving logical propositions and linear inequalities.
sentences.zh: 此类知识常常被表达为涉及逻辑命题与线性不等式的规则。

sentences.en: Existing neuro-symbolic methods typically enforce these rules approximately through soft penalties, assume input-independent rules when designing specialized architectures, or rely on non-differentiable post-processing at inference time to achieve hard constraint satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 现有的神经符号方法通常通过软惩罚近似地强制这些规则，在设计专门架构时假设与输入无关的规则，或依赖推理时不可微的后处理来实现硬约束满足。

sentences.en: While recent advances in differentiable optimization layers enable end-to-end feasibility enforcement within neural networks, extending these approaches to logical or mixed-integer rules remains challenging due to inherent nonconvexity.
sentences.zh: 虽然可微优化层的近期进展支持神经网络内端到端的可行性强制，但由于固有的非凸性，将这些方法扩展到逻辑或混合整数规则仍然充满挑战。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a unified end-to-end framework for enforcing hard, input-dependent mixed integer linear constraints within neural networks.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一个统一端到端框架，用于在神经网络内强制硬的、依赖于输入的混合整数线性约束。

sentences.en: Our approach represents rules as disjunctive constraints and applies hierarchical convex relaxations to obtain convex hull formulations.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法将规则表示为析取约束，并应用分层凸松弛获得凸包表述。

sentences.en: These relaxations yield tractable linear constraints that can be embedded as differentiable optimization layers while enabling exact rule satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 这些松弛产生可处理的线性约束，可以作为可微优化层嵌入，同时实现精确的规则满足。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on real-world datasets, achieving perfect rule satisfaction and strong predictive performance.
sentences.zh: 我们在真实世界数据集上展示所提出框架的有效性，实现完美的规则满足与强预测性能。

title_en: Dismantling Pathological Shortcuts: A Causal Framework for Faithful LVLM Decoding
title_zh: 拆除病态捷径：用于大型视觉语言模型忠实解码的因果框架

sentences.en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit sophisticated reasoning but remain susceptible to object hallucination.
sentences.zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）展现出精妙的推理，但仍容易产生物体幻觉。

sentences.en: Deviating from the prevailing *attention intensity assumption*, we reveal a deeper dynamic structural misalignment: hallucination is triggered at decision-critical steps where specific attention heads, acting as risky mediators, decouple from visual evidence to lock onto language priors.
sentences.zh: 偏离主流的*注意力强度假设*，我们揭示出更深层的动态结构错位：幻觉在决策关键步骤被触发，此时充当风险中介的特定注意力头与视觉证据解耦，锁定到语言先验上。

sentences.en: This establishes a pathological shortcut that bypasses visual grounding.
sentences.zh: 这确立了一条绕过视觉立足的病理性捷径。

sentences.en: To dismantle this, we propose **Fox** (*F*aithfulness and *O*bservational-flow via e*X*pression-rectification), a training-free inference-time framework.
sentences.zh: 为拆除它，我们提出 **Fox**（通过表述校正的忠实性与观察流），一个免训练的推理时框架。

sentences.en: **Fox** diagnoses structural misalignment using a visual attention entropy probe to localize risky mediators unsupervisedly.
sentences.zh: **Fox** 使用视觉注意力熵探针诊断结构错位，以无监督方式定位风险中介。

sentences.en: We then execute a targeted causal intervention via numerical logit saturation to physically sever the shortcut path.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们通过数值 logit 饱和执行一次针对性的因果干预，以物理上切断捷径路径。

sentences.en: Finally, a conflict-gated cooperative decoding strategy reconciles interventional faithfulness with observational fluency.
sentences.zh: 最后，一种冲突门控协作解码策略调和干预性忠实性与观察性流畅性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that **Fox** achieves SOTA performance, outperforming SID by $29.1\%$ while preserving linguistic richness.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，**Fox** 实现 SOTA 性能，以 $29.1\%$ 超越 SID，同时保留语言丰富性。

title_en: Dismantling the Illusion of Vision-Language-Action Models Competence via Explicit Distributional Shifts
title_zh: 通过显式分布偏移揭穿视觉–语言–动作模型的能力假象

sentences.en: Given that simulation can never exhaustively enumerate reality, generalization is the determining factor for whether Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can translate benchmark success into real-world functionality.
sentences.zh: 鉴于模拟永远无法穷尽地枚举现实，泛化是决定视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能否将基准成功转化为现实功能的决定性因素。

sentences.en: However, current evaluation protocols often incentivize mechanical memorization rather than robust policy learning, leading to a paradoxical duality of failure: high-scoring models exhibit *spurious invariance* to semantic changes while simultaneously displaying *extreme brittleness* to trivial environmental perturbations.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的评估协议常常激励机械记忆而非稳健的策略学习，导致一种矛盾的失效二元性：高分模型对语义变化表现出*虚假不变性*，同时却对琐碎的环境扰动表现出*极端脆弱性*。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce **LIBERO-Gen**, a diagnostic benchmark systematically designed to shift evaluation from intuition-driven heuristics to explicit distributional assumptions.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们引入 **LIBERO-Gen**，一个系统设计为将评估从直觉驱动的启发式转向显式分布假设的诊断基准。

sentences.en: Through a hierarchical protocol spanning **In-distribution**, **Compositional**, and **Domain Generalization**, LIBERO-Gen reveals performance stratifications previously masked by standard metrics.
sentences.zh: 通过涵盖**分布内**、**组合**与**领域泛化**的层级协议，LIBERO-Gen 揭示了此前被标准指标掩盖的性能分层。

sentences.en: Our analysis identifies Pi0.5 as the top performer (64.0% in Spatial-CG; 21.2% in Task-CG).
sentences.zh: 我们的分析将 Pi0.5 识别为最佳执行者（Spatial-CG 中为 64.0%；Task-CG 中为 21.2%）。

sentences.en: By identifying perceptual instability and action binding collapse as primary failure modes while validating the efficacy of structured ``Stair” sampling, LIBERO-Gen establishes a rigorous baseline for deployment reliability.
sentences.zh: 通过将感知不稳定与动作绑定坍缩识别为主要失效模式，同时验证结构化的“Stair”采样的有效性，LIBERO-Gen 为部署可靠性确立了严格的基线。

title_en: Dispersion Loss Counteracts Embedding Condensation and Improves Generalization in Small Language Models
title_zh: 离散度损失对抗嵌入凝聚并改善小语言模型泛化

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance through ever-increasing parameter counts, but scaling incurs steep computational costs.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通过不断增加的参数数量取得非凡性能，但扩展招致陡峭的计算成本。

sentences.en: To better understand LLM scaling, we study representational differences between LLMs and their smaller counterparts, with the goal of replicating the representational qualities of larger models in smaller models.
sentences.zh: 为更好地理解 LLM 扩展，我们研究 LLM 与其较小对应模型之间的表示差异，目标是在较小模型中复现更大模型的表示质量。

sentences.en: We observe a geometric phenomenon which we term $\textbf{embedding condensation}$, where token embeddings collapse into a narrow cone-like subspace in some language models.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到一个我们称之为 **embedding condensation**（嵌入凝聚）的几何现象，其中某些语言模型中的词元嵌入坍缩进一个狭窄的类锥形子空间。

sentences.en: Through systematic analyses across multiple Transformer families, we show that small models such as $\texttt{GPT2}$ and $\texttt{Qwen3-0.6B}$ exhibit severe condensation, whereas larger models such as $\texttt{GPT2-xl}$ and $\texttt{Qwen3-32B}$ are more resistant to this phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 通过在多个 Transformer 家族的跨系统性分析，我们表明诸如 $\texttt{GPT2}$ 与 $\texttt{Qwen3-0.6B}$ 的小模型表现出严重凝聚，而诸如 $\texttt{GPT2-xl}$ 与 $\texttt{Qwen3-32B}$ 的更大模型对这一现象更具抵抗力。

sentences.en: Additional observations show that embedding condensation is not reliably mitigated by knowledge distillation from larger models.
sentences.zh: 额外的观察表明，嵌入凝聚并不能被来自更大模型的知识蒸馏可靠缓解。

sentences.en: To fight against it, we formulate a dispersion loss that explicitly encourages embedding dispersion during training.
sentences.zh: 为对抗它，我们定义一个离散度损失，在训练期间显式鼓励嵌入离散。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that it mitigates condensation, recovers dispersion patterns seen in larger models, and yields performance gains across 10 benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，它缓解凝聚、恢复在更大模型中看到的离散模式，并在 10 个基准上带来性能增益。

sentences.en: We believe this work offers a principled path toward improving smaller Transformers without additional parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们相信这项工作提供了一条无需额外参数改进较小 Transformer 的有原则路径。

title_en: DisPOSE: Projected Polystochastic Diffusion for Self-Supervised Multi-View 3D Human Pose Estimation
title_zh: DisPOSE：通过投影多随机扩散进行自监督多视图三维人体姿态估计

sentences.en: Recovering 3D human poses for multiple individuals from different camera views is a fundamental bottleneck for analyzing interacting behaviors.
sentences.zh: 从不同相机视角恢复多个个体的 3D 人体姿态，是分析交互行为的基本瓶颈。

sentences.en: Existing self-supervised approaches leverage synthetic catalogues of 3D poses; however, this leads to poor generalization in real-world scenarios due to distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 现有的自监督方法利用 3D 姿态的合成目录；然而，由于分布偏移，这在现实场景中导致较差的泛化。

sentences.en: We therefore introduce DisPOSE, a self-supervised framework that approximates the inherently discrete multi-view person-assignment problem as a generative diffusion process over the space of polystochastic tensors.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们引入 DisPOSE，一个将本质上离散的多视角人员分配问题逼近为多随机张量空间上的生成扩散过程的自监督框架。

sentences.en: By employing differentiable Sinkhorn projections during denoising, our model learns to guide solutions toward valid and feasible assignments based on 2D image priors.
sentences.zh: 通过在去噪期间采用可微 Sinkhorn 投影，我们的模型学会基于 2D 图像先验引导解走向有效且可行的分配。

sentences.en: The complete 3D skeletons of localized individuals are then regressed using a Hypergraph-Convolutional Decoder that explicitly models relational structures and articulated joints across multiple views.
sentences.zh: 然后，使用一个超图卷积解码器回归已定位个体的完整 3D 骨架，该解码器显式建模跨多个视角的关系结构与关节。

sentences.en: The proposed approach outperforms current state-of-the-art self-supervised methods on standard datasets and demonstrates strong performance on a newly proposed benchmark featuring highly occluded scenes from surgical operating rooms.
sentences.zh: 所提出的方法在标准数据集上超越当前最先进的自监督方法，并在一个以手术室中高度遮挡场景为特征的新提出的基准上展现强劲性能。

sentences.en: Our diffusion-based localization demonstrates high label efficiency, retaining 99\% of its performance with only 10\% of the pseudo-labels.
sentences.zh: 我们的基于扩散的定位展现出高标签效率，仅用 10\% 的伪标签就保留 99\% 的性能。

sentences.en: Notably, disentangling the assignment and root regression components while maintaining differentiability makes DisPOSE nearly agnostic to different camera arrangements.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，在保持可微性的同时解缠分配与根回归组件，使 DisPOSE 几乎不受不同相机布置的影响。

title_en: DisPPO: Quantile-Based Distributional Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
title_zh: DisPPO：用于大语言模型的基于分位数的分布强化学习

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become a cornerstone for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为增强大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的基石。

sentences.en: However, standard actor-critic methods, such as PPO, rely on scalar value functions that estimate only the expectation of cumulative returns.
sentences.zh: 然而，诸如 PPO 的标准 actor-critic 方法依赖仅估计累积回报期望的标量值函数。

sentences.en: This reduction inherently discards higher-order statistical information (e.g., variance and multimodality), leading to inaccurate value estimation and suboptimal credit assignment in complex tasks.
sentences.zh: 这种化简本质上丢弃了高阶统计信息（例如方差与多模态性），导致复杂任务中值估计不准确与次优信用分配。

sentences.en: While Distributional RL offers a solution by modeling the full return distribution, its application to LLMs remains challenging due to the computational intractability of value-based operations over large vocabularies and the instability and memory burden of off-policy replay mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 虽然分布式 RL 通过建模完整回报分布提供解决方案，但其在 LLM 中的应用仍充满挑战，因为在大词汇表上基于值的运算的计算不可处理性，以及离策略回放机制的不稳定性与内存负担。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose DisPPO, a novel on-policy framework that seamlessly integrates non-parametric quantile regression into PPO.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 DisPPO，一个无缝地将非参数分位数回归整合进 PPO 的新颖在策略框架。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that our distributional update operator---composed of the $\lambda$-return Bellman operator and quantile projection---is a contraction mapping in the Wasserstein metric, guaranteeing convergence to a unique fixed point.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们证明我们的分布更新算子——由 $\lambda$-返回 Bellman 算子与分位数投影组成——在 Wasserstein 度量中是压缩映射，保证收敛到唯一不动点。

sentences.en: Empirically, we evaluate DisPPO using Llama and Qwen models across diverse benchmarks, including mathematical reasoning and Text-to-SQL generation.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们使用 Llama 与 Qwen 模型在多样基准上评估 DisPPO，包括数学推理与 Text-to-SQL 生成。

sentences.en: DisPPO consistently outperforms standard PPO and recent group-based baselines in both Pass@1 and Pass@$k$ metrics, demonstrating that distributional critics provide a richer, more robust learning signal for large-scale reasoning models.
sentences.zh: DisPPO 在 Pass@1 与 Pass@$k$ 指标上都一致地超越标准 PPO 与近期的基于分组的基线，表明分布式评论家为大规模推理模型提供更丰富、更稳健的学习信号。

title_en: Dissect and Prune: Enhancing Robustness in AI-Generated Image Detection
title_zh: 剖析与剪枝：增强 AI 生成图像检测的鲁棒性

sentences.en: While existing AI-generated image detectors report high performance, we identify that this is largely driven by a critical *prediction asymmetry*: a bias toward the real class that severely limits sensitivity to generated content, especially under standard post-processing operations such as compression and resizing.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有的 AI 生成图像检测器报告了高性能，但我们识别出这在很大程度上由一种关键的*预测不对称性*驱动：一种偏向真实类别的偏差严重限制了对生成内容的敏感性，尤其是在压缩与缩放等标准后处理操作下。

sentences.en: We hypothesize that this stems from the model's reliance on spurious features, distracting signals that obscure true generative artifacts.
sentences.zh: 我们假设这源于模型对虚假特征的依赖——这些干扰信号遮蔽了真实的生成伪影。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose DEAR (Dissect and Prune), which leverages inpainted images to identify and prune these interfering components.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出 DEAR（解剖并剪枝），它利用修复图像识别并剪除这些干扰组件。

sentences.en: Specifically, we find that features strongly aligned to either inpainted or non-inpainted regions are less robust to post-processing.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们发现与修复或非修复区域强对齐的特征对后处理较不稳健。

sentences.en: By measuring the alignment between channel activations and inpaint masks, DEAR removes features at both extremes, retaining only those that capture genuine generative artifacts.
sentences.zh: 通过度量通道激活与修复掩码之间的对齐，DEAR 移除两个极端的特征，仅保留捕获真实生成伪影的特征。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances robustness against unseen generators and post-processing, effectively mitigating the prediction asymmetry.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，我们的方法显著增强了对未见生成器与后处理的稳健性，有效缓解预测不对称性。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/dahyedahye/dear.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/dahyedahye/dear 获取。

title_en: Dissecting Causal Mechanism Shifts via FANS: Function And Noise Separation
title_zh: 通过 FANS 剖析因果机制变化：函数与噪声分离

sentences.en: Identifying the drivers of causal mechanism shifts, distinguishing functional changes from noise alterations, termed *dissection*, is a critical yet under-explored problem in data science (e.g., biomedical science and manufacturing).
sentences.zh: 识别因果机制偏移的驱动因素、区分功能变化与噪声改变（称为*解剖*），是数据科学（例如生物医学科学与制造）中一个关键但未充分探索的问题。

sentences.en: This paper introduces a more general and unified framework, the *function and noise separation* (FANS) framework, that detects and dissects shifts in non-additive, non-linear Structural Causal Models (SCMs) beyond existing additive noise models.
sentences.zh: 本文引入一个更一般且统一的框架，即*函数与噪声分离*（FANS）框架，它在现有加性噪声模型之外，检测并解剖非加性、非线性结构因果模型（SCM）中的偏移。

sentences.en: Our approach is grounded in a theoretical independence criterion, where function shifts induce a statistical dependence between a node's parents and residual noise.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法植根于一个理论独立准则，其中函数偏移在节点的父节点与残差噪声之间诱导统计依赖。

sentences.en: Building on this foundation, we develop a practical two-stage algorithm to efficiently detect and dissect these shifts without retraining.
sentences.zh: 在此基础之上，我们开发一个实用的两阶段算法，无需重训即可高效检测与解剖这些偏移。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we address the complex challenge of simultaneous function and noise shifts, introducing a formal assumption to resolve their inherent non-identifiability.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们应对同时发生函数与噪声偏移的复杂挑战，引入一个形式化假设以解决其固有的不可辨识性。

sentences.en: Our results are corroborated by simulations.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果得到模拟的佐证。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/MLAI-Yonsei/FANS/.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/MLAI-Yonsei/FANS/ 获取。

title_en: Dissecting Multimodal In-Context Learning: Modality Asymmetries and Circuit Dynamics in modern Transformers
title_zh: 剖析多模态上下文学习：现代 Transformer 中的模态不对称性与回路动态

sentences.en: Transformer-based multimodal large language models often exhibit in-context learning (ICL) capabilities.
sentences.zh: 基于 Transformer 的多模态大语言模型常常展现出上下文学习（ICL）能力。

sentences.en: Motivated by this phenomenon, we ask: how do transformers learn to associate information across modalities from in-context examples?
sentences.zh: 受这一现象激励，我们发问：Transformer 如何学会从上下文示例中关联跨模态的信息？

sentences.en: We investigate this through controlled experiments on small transformers trained on synthetic classification tasks, enabling precise manipulation of data statistics and model architecture.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在合成分类任务上训练的小型 Transformer 上进行受控实验来研究这一点，从而能够精确操控数据统计量与模型架构。

sentences.en: We begin by revisiting core principles of unimodal ICL in modern transformers.
sentences.zh: 我们首先重新考察现代 Transformer 中单模态 ICL 的核心原理。

sentences.en: While several prior findings replicate, we find that Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) can delay the onset of ICL circuits.
sentences.zh: 虽然若干先前发现得到复现，但我们发现旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）会延迟 ICL 电路的启动。

sentences.en: Extending to the multimodal setting reveals a fundamental learning asymmetry: when pretrained on high-diversity data from a primary modality, surprisingly low data complexity in the secondary modality suffices for multimodal ICL to emerge.
sentences.zh: 扩展到多模态情境揭示了一种基本学习不对称：当在来自主模态的高多样性数据上预训练时，令人惊讶地低复杂度的次模态数据就足以使多模态 ICL 涌现。

sentences.en: Mechanistic analysis shows that both settings rely on an induction-style mechanism that copies labels from matching in-context exemplars; multimodal training refines and extends these circuits across modalities.
sentences.zh: 机理分析表明，两种情境都依赖一种从匹配的上下文示例中复制标签的归纳式机制；多模态训练精炼并将这些电路扩展到跨模态。

sentences.en: Our findings provide a mechanistic foundation for understanding multimodal ICL in modern transformers and introduce a controlled testbed for future investigation.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现为理解现代 Transformer 中的多模态 ICL 提供了机理基础，并为未来研究引入一个受控测试平台。

title_en: Dissecting Post-Training: Uncovering the Complementary Roles of SFT and RL for Document Parsing
title_zh: 剖析后训练：揭示监督微调与强化学习在文档解析中的互补作用

sentences.en: Document parsing, the task of extracting diverse content from PDFs while preserving their structural integrity, has been significantly advanced by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).
sentences.zh: 文档解析（从 PDF 中提取多样内容同时保持其结构完整性的任务）已被多模态大语言模型（MLLM）显著推进。

sentences.en: These models have achieved remarkable success, largely driven by extensive post-training on massive datasets.
sentences.zh: 这些模型取得显著成功，很大程度上得益于在巨量数据集上的广泛后训练。

sentences.en: This paper therefore undertakes a deep analysis of the two dominant adaptation strategies, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), prompted by a puzzling observation on the PDF-to-Markdown task: SFT makes a negligible impact, especially on parsing complex tables and formulas, while RL achieves substantial overall gains.
sentences.zh: 本文因此对两种主导的适配策略——监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）——进行深入分析，缘由是在 PDF 转 Markdown 任务上的一个令人困惑的观察：SFT 的影响可忽略，尤其是在解析复杂表格与公式时，而 RL 取得实质性的整体增益。

sentences.en: To unravel the reasons, our systematic investigation reveals a clear and complementary division of labor: SFT primarily operates as a structure learner, biased towards mastering the low-entropy syntax of document layouts.
sentences.zh: 为揭开原因，我们的系统调查揭示了一种清晰且互补的分工：SFT 主要作为结构学习器运作，偏向掌握文档布局的低熵语法。

sentences.en: While it learns the format of a table, it struggles to ensure the fidelity of its high-entropy cell content.
sentences.zh: 虽然它学会表格的格式，但它难以确保其高熵单元格内容的保真度。

sentences.en: Conversely, RL excels as a content refiner by optimizing a holistic reward that reflects final accuracy.
sentences.zh: 相反，RL 作为内容精炼器表现出色，通过优化反映最终准确率的整体奖励。

sentences.en: We further ground this phenomenon in the distinct theoretical nature of their respective objective functions.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将这一现象植根于它们各自目标函数的不同理论性质。

sentences.en: Based on these findings, we introduce a unified strategy that explicitly harnesses their individual strengths while mitigating their weaknesses.
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现，我们引入一个统一策略，显式利用它们各自的优势同时缓解各自的弱点。

sentences.en: This work shows that a deep understanding of post-training methods is key to unlocking performance beyond what data scaling alone can achieve.
sentences.zh: 这项工作表明，对后训练方法的深刻理解是解锁超越仅数据扩展所能达到性能的关键。

title_en: Dissecting Quantization Error: A Concentration-Alignment Perspective
title_zh: 剖析量化误差：集中性–对齐视角

sentences.en: Quantization can drastically increase the efficiency of large language and vision models, but typically incurs an accuracy drop.
sentences.zh: 量化可以大幅提高大型语言与视觉模型的效率，但通常会招致准确率下降。

sentences.en: Recently, function-preserving transforms (e.g. rotations, Hadamard transform, channel-wise scaling) have been successfully applied to reduce post-training quantization error, yet a principled explanation remains elusive.
sentences.zh: 近来，保持函数的变换（例如旋转、Hadamard 变换、逐通道缩放）已被成功应用于减少后训练量化误差，然而一个有原则的解释仍然难以捉摸。

sentences.en: We analyze linear-layer quantization via the signal-to-quantization-noise ratio (SQNR), showing that for uniform integer quantization at a fixed bit width, SQNR decomposes into (i) the concentration of weights and activations (capturing spread and outliers), and (ii) the alignment of their dominant variation directions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过信号与量化噪声比（SQNR）分析线性层量化，表明对于固定位宽的一致整数量化，SQNR 分解为（i）权重与激活的集中度（捕获散布与离群值），以及（ii）它们主变化方向的对齐。

sentences.en: This provides an actionable insight: enhancing alignment between weight and activation variation directions can reduce quantization error, complementing concentration-focused approaches.
sentences.zh: 这提供了可操作的洞见：增强权重与激活变化方向之间的对齐可以减少量化误差，补充聚焦于集中度的方法。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we introduce Concentration–Alignment Transforms (CAT), a lightweight linear transformation that uses a covariance estimate from a small calibration set to jointly improve concentration and alignment, approximately maximizing SQNR.
sentences.zh: 受此激励，我们引入集中-对齐变换（CAT），一个使用来自小型校准集的协方差估计来联合改善集中度与对齐的轻量级线性变换，近似最大化 SQNR。

sentences.en: Experiments across several LLMs show that CAT consistently matches or outperforms prior transform-based quantization methods at 4-bit precision.
sentences.zh: 在几个 LLM 上的实验表明，CAT 在 4 位精度下一致匹配或超越先前的基于变换的量化方法。

title_en: Dissecting the Safety Circuit: Neuronal Intervention for Transferable Adversarial Attacks on VLMs
title_zh: 剖析安全回路：通过神经元干预对视觉语言模型实施可迁移对抗攻击

sentences.en: The limited transferability of adversarial attacks on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) stems from their failure to navigate model-specific safety alignments, where superficial perturbations exploit surrogate-specific artifacts rather than shared safety-critical features.
sentences.zh: 对视觉-语言模型（VLM）对抗攻击的有限可迁移性源于它们无法穿越模型特定的安全对齐，其中表面扰动利用的是代理特定的伪影而非共享的安全关键特征。

sentences.en: We reveal through linear probing that safety-related representations are concentrated within specific intermediate neuronal circuits, which act as localized defense bottlenecks that can be disentangled from transferable features.
sentences.zh: 通过线性探针，我们揭示安全相关的表示集中在特定的中间神经元电路内，这些电路充当局部化防御瓶颈，可以与可迁移特征解缠。

sentences.en: To overcome this barrier, we propose the Safety Circuit Intervention Attack (SCIA), a framework that surgically steers internal representations to bypass these localized safety mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一障碍，我们提出安全电路干预攻击（SCIA），一个外科手术式地引导内部表示以绕过这些局部安全机制的框架。

sentences.en: SCIA employs a dual-objective steering strategy that suppresses the defensive circuit encoding safety features while amplifying the transferable circuit capturing model-agnostic representations, effectively decoupling adversarial patterns from surrogate-specific safety behaviors.
sentences.zh: SCIA 采用双目标引导策略，抑制编码安全特性的防御电路，同时放大捕获模型无关表示的迁移电路，有效将对抗模式与代理特定的安全行为解耦。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we incorporate contrastive semantic steering and spectral smoothness regularization to guide optimization toward compliant semantic regions while producing visually coherent perturbations.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们纳入对比语义引导与谱平滑正则化，以引导优化朝向合规语义区域，同时产生视觉连贯的扰动。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that SCIA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in bypassing unseen black-box VLMs.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，SCIA 在绕过未见黑盒 VLM 方面显著超越最先进方法。

title_en: DISSOLVR: An Interpretable and Fast Framework for Aqueous and Organic Solubility Prediction
title_zh: DISSOLVR：用于水相与有机相溶解度预测的可解释快速框架

sentences.en: High-fidelity solubility prediction is fundamental to pharmaceutical development and environmental partitioning, where accurate modeling must couple molecular structure with thermodynamic behavior across diverse chemical environments.
sentences.zh: 高保真溶解度预测是药物开发与环境分配的基础，其中准确建模必须将分子结构与跨多样化学环境的热力学行为耦合。

sentences.en: However, recent advancements have been dominated by deep learning architectures that often sacrifice physical interpretability for predictive power.
sentences.zh: 然而，近期的进展已被深度学习架构主导，它们常常为了预测力而牺牲物理可解释性。

sentences.en: We challenge this trend by showing that state-of-the-art performance does not require such non-transparent architectures.
sentences.zh: 我们挑战这一趋势，表明最先进的性能并不需要此类不透明的架构。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce DISSOLVR, a transparent framework for molecular solubility prediction.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们引入 DISSOLVR，一个透明的分子溶解度预测框架。

sentences.en: In addition, we perform a comprehensive literature review and a benchmarking study against various methods.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们进行全面的文献综述与跨各种方法的基准研究。

sentences.en: We show that Dissolvr approaches the aleatoric limit of experimental uncertainty and achieves OOD generalization through structural invariance derived by mapping molecules to physically-grounded descriptors.
sentences.zh: 我们表明 Dissolvr 接近实验不确定性的临界极限，并通过将分子映射到物理立足的描述符所得的结构不变性实现 OOD 泛化。

sentences.en: Then, we present an LLM-assisted post-hoc explanation pipeline that bridges the gap between symbolic model artifacts and chemically grounded narratives.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们提出一个 LLM 辅助的事后解释流水线，它弥合符号模型产物与化学立足叙事之间的差距。

sentences.en: Finally, a comparative benchmark of a survey involving 22 expert chemists reveals that expert evaluators provide deep insights.
sentences.zh: 最后，一项涉及 22 位专家化学家的调查的比较基准揭示，专家评估者提供了深刻的洞见。
